tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dza pa ra mār+tha sarba karmo da ya ut+ta ra tan+t+ra rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos bstan 'bras bu la sbyar ba'i dbang du byas na/ de nas bskyed rim la sbyar ba 'di dag gis dol sgrub pa'ang bstan/ rdzogs rim la sbyar na thun mong ba <thun mong ma yin pa rnams 'dir bshad la > rnams sgra ji bzhin pa dang mtshungs pa'ang yod la/ bcom <bdud bzhi > ldan 'das ma chen mo ji bzhin sgra la 'dis ye shes tshogs gsog go /snying gi thig le dang lte ba'i gtum mo ni de bzhin gshegs pa phung po lnga thams cad skyed byed kyi btsun mo'i mchog shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dam pa te tshig spyi bo'i haṃ sgrol ma ni <mgrin pa'i oṃ > gong bzhin zhes bya ba/ bar do sbyong byed du byas te/ ༈ 'a dir yang na spyod pa la sbyar ba'i dbang du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs <khyab byed > pa dang*/ pad+ma can ma/ rdo rje <srog 'dzin > dang*/ glang chen rin po <thur sel > che dang*/ dung can ma dang*/ pad+ma <gyen rgyu > dang*/ ri mo can las kyi rigs <nyams gnas > sna tshogs can te rigs lnga sgrol ma rgyal ba rigs lnga thams cad kyi spyi'i yum yin pas na thams cad kyi bdag po/ mi shig pa'i thig le de nyid rgyu <bcud > ba ni zhing du 'gro ba'i spyod pa dang mi rgyu <snod > ba sa cig pu 'dug pa'i spyod pas lha dang gzhal yas khang 'i <sgo nas 'gro don mdzad pas > byed pa po/ sems nyid brtan <thugs chos sku > pa ni khang pa tshogs khang rtsa dang thig le dang g.yo <rlung > ba'i <thams cad > rnal 'byor pa lha'i 'dram 'bag rang bzhin ste tshogs kyi bdag po'i spyod pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ gsang ba spros bcas kyi spyod pa las theg dman la ches shin tu <spros med > gsang ba/ <rjes su rnal 'byor/>

phyi rol pa la gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug <shin tu spros med > mas rjes su rnal 'byor spyod pa bdag nyid kyi ngo bo rdo rje <'od gsal > te 'od gsal rgyal 'dod rgyal du 'jug pa 'i ming <rnal 'byor chen po > 'di rnams nyid kyi sgo gsum sku mi shig pa dang gsung mi shig pa dang thugs mi shig pa rdo rje'i <ra byed pas rnal 'byor gsum/> las <'dis dkyil 'khor bstan > phyung <te spros shing gsungs pa'i don no/> ngo*/ / dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa bcom ldan 'das ma/ dang*/ sgrol ma/ <gong bzhin > rdzogs rim thams cad lta bas zin par bstan/ mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje <zla ba rdo rje'i sems skye3gt; ma/ 'di gnyis kyis mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa bstan/ dam tshig sgrol ma dam tshig la bzhag pa/ dbyer mi phyed pas rdo rje <lus lha'i lus bstan pa ni > ye shes dbab rnal 'byor ma thabs shes gnyis med chen mo/ lnga po 'dis gtso mo yod/ me long lta bu sogs ye shes dgug gzhug lngas brgyan <rigs pa'i dbang lnga > pa ma/ hūṃ gi gzungs kyi sgo 'dis bstan/ rgyun mtha'i skabs su sangs rgyas thams cad nam mkha' dbang lha bstan kyis dbang bskur <dbang len pa bstan > ma/ lam gyi dbang dang dga' ba bzhis dbang bzhi thob pa bstan/ shes rab ma'i bha ga rtsa'i dkyil dang bcas pa ni ye shes shes bya'i dkyil dbang bskur bya'i dal bstan 'khor/ <thams cad la sprul pa ste de ji snyed mkhyen pa > <gsal snang la sems 'dzin pa/> yon tan thabs dga' bzhi/ zla ba'i bde ma/ <sher dbang gi ngo bo'o/> /te zhu bde mas bstan dga' bzhi/ ngo <bzhi pa'i ngo bo > mtshar <zhing rtogs dka' ba'i > bde ma/ <rang bzhin lhan skyes/> <'di gnyis kyis bde ba la sems 'dzin pa/> dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs <rlung 'bru gsum dang sbyar ba'i rdor bzlas/> rdo rje bdag mo ste rang bzhin kyi 'dod ma/

gnas gsum byin brlabs/ 'di sogs bzhi ye shes la sbyor/ phung po <lnga rigs lnga gnas gyur pas/> 'od gsal 'jug pa 'i bdag mo/ sngags kyi go cha skye mched drug sems pa drug tu gnas gyur pa kyi bdag mor gzung 'dzin gyi rlung bcu gnyis 'ching ba gyur pa/ go cha 'ching ba/ snying ga nas rgyu ba'i 'byung bzhi'i rlung 'gags pa/ 'byung ba bzhi rnams lha mo bzhir rab tu thob pa/ las bzhi dang*/ gzung 'dzin gyi yul can/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ <blta ba bstan/> las tshogs 'grub pas/ rgyud <rtsa gsum > kun gyi slob dpon du gnang ba thob pa/ dbang phyug <dbu > ma/ te mchog tu gyur pa/ lam dus kyi <yang rgya khar mngon byang gi > ye shes rnam pa <shes rab ye shes kyi skabs/> lngas byang chub pa/ <skyed chog mngon byang lnga/><sems zin na > rdul <'di nas lnga dbang bzhi pa yan lag bdun ldan ston > mtshan byas mtshan med kyi rnam rtog ni dang bral ba/ sgrib pa gnyis kyi dri ma med pa/ <'gro ba thams cad kyi yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa/> gsang sngags chen mo/ <rang gi rnam rtog rags pa skyobs/> ye shes kyi rang snang ma gtogs rdul gyi lus spangs pas shin tu phra ba/ 'a ja' tshon lta bur sgom dgos so/ / longs sku de nyid/ mtshan <sgyu lus kyi rdzogs rim bstan/> dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/ 'od gsal <sems can gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa sher dbang gi > dag byed/ bar chad/ zung 'jug dag <shes sgrib kyi > <bzhi pa'o// > byed chen mo/ rnam rtog dag lha <'di nas myur ma zhes pa man chad sprul sku'i rnam gzhag gtso che > mo'i sngags bzlas na/ <'byung bzhi'i rlung > las <bzhi > thams cad grub par byed pa/ <bum dbang gis so//> rdzogs rim kho nas 'dod pa dngos grub thams cad gsang dbang gis rab tu sbyin pa/ gtso bor thun mong pa 'grub/ ༈ rlung 'od zer bcu rnam par dag pas/ <phar phyin > yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrog pa/

bzlas pa'o/ /yi ge sgra sgrog te he ru ka dgyes ma/ <te kha sbyor gyi sku ston/> ngag 'dren rnams brten/ ༈ snying rjes sems can la/ gdung ma/ thig le 'dzin pa 'gro ba'i don myur ma/ <khyab pa > byin rlabs myur rnam par shes pa <tshogs brgyad/> yongs su dag pa/ go 'phang mi 'jigs pa <rlung dang sre bas bstan pa > sra zhing rang bzhin bde ba/ dbyings su skyal ba ni/ ye shes kyi snying po/ rtogs pas ji lta ba'i mkhyen pa/ mthong lam nas rang bzhin lhan skyes rtogs pas/ bde ba chen mo <'i sku3gt; 'o/ / 'di rnams kyi rgyud pa'i sgyur bas so/ / de la he ru ka'i dal/ 'di ni 'jig rten dang lo ka las 'das pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi spyod pa la 'dus shing dam tshig la 'jog par byed pa'i gnas <tshig 'di mtshan nges la sbyor kyang mi 'grig cing 'grel ba gnyis na bshad pa med/ mtshan nges pa'i des logs su yod pa la'ang 'di bris snang la kha/ kha cig med pa'i skyon du 'dod/> so/ / rang lugs bla ma'i man ngag la ltos pa'i phyir tshig 'di gnyis grub pa yin/ don dam pa'i mtshan de skad ces rnams kyang bka' stsal to/ / ༈ thabs kyi dum bu 'di nas mgo brtsams pa'o/ /de las thabs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ dang po ngos bzung ba ni/ de nas he ru ka'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor/ / 'di bsgos na/ gnyis pa phan yon 'dod pa mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad rab tu sgrub/ / <pa'i thabs te/> zhi ba'am/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog gyur te gzhan thams cad las ches zab pa ste dngos grub myur ba zhig gsungs/ / so/ /gsum pa skyed chog ni/ ma mo ste mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus pa 'i dkyil 'khor sgoms pas nyams dga'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi 'dul 'phral du ma thob par 'gyur ba gnas/ / so/ /'grel chen las gzhal yas khang du bshad/ nyi ma ni ma mo dbyangs yig yin skyed chog stan zer/ ā li

las zla ba kā li las nyi/ / ma dbus su hūṃ gi ye shes te sa bon rnams 'dres pa las rdo rje sems/ / par sgom ces 'grel ba gnyis ka 'chad/ man ngag las sa bon nyid sku rdo rje sems pa'o/ ༈ /gcig tu 'dres pa'i thig le'i 'od zer/ phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rnams <su > spro ba/ / byas la don gnyis bya/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngags 'dir mgon po rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo thig le bskul bar bya/ / 'o/ /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya hoḥ bskul ba las bzhengs pa ste/ bzhi pa lha'i rnam pa'i khyad par ni rdo rje mi skyod pa zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid ni/ / sku mdog nag po zhal nas hūṃ sgrog ban+dhu <ltar dmar ba3gt; 'i mig / gsum pa/ g.yas dang po/ rdo rje g.yon dang po thod pas khrag gis gang ba lag sbrel ba/ / g.yas gnyis pa rtse gsum g.yon gnyis pa srin po'i mgrin pa btsir/ ba yum/ khro mo'i dbang phyug sngon po gri thod 'dzin pas sku la 'khyud/ / pa'o/ / 'grel par yum dmar mo bya/ lo gā pra da'i sgrub na yum kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnam par mdzad do/ /sku stod la mi lpags rlon pa'i na bzar bcas/ / shing*/ skra ser gyen du 'khyil ba'o/ / 'di nas gtum mo'o/ /zhes pa'i bar rgya skad lhug pa yin na'ang brjod pa bde bas tshigs bcad du sdebs/ gau rī dang tsau rī dang rab rmongs ma dang*/ /ro langs ma dang sbos mo dang za nus ma/ / dang*/ dur khrod ma dang gtum mo rnams/ / sku mdog ni rim pas sngo na mo dang ser mo dang btsod kyi mdog/ can dang*/ gnag pa dang dmar ser dang ljang khu dang*/ /sngo bsangs dang de bzhin du ser skya'o/ / mig zim bu 'dod pas myos pa lta bu zhi ba'i lta stangs can/ gau ṝ keng rus kyi dbyug pa dur khrod rgyu ba'i keng rus kyi 'byung po'i gtso bo yin pa'i brda'o/ / dang*/ /thod pa g.yas dang g.yon par bsnams/ /

drag mo'i lta stangs 'bru tshugs su lta ba tsau rī mda' gzhu 'gengs byed ma/ / bdud kyi 'khor brdul nas lam la bkod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dbang gi las la sngags pa rnams kyi gtso mo yin pa'i brda'o/ / rab rmongs ma rab rmongs kyi lta stangs chang gis bzi ba lta bur mi gsal bar lta ba/ rgyal mtshan chu srin gyi tog can dang*/ thod pa 'dzin/ / bdud kyi bu mo he ru ka'i rdul te mkha' 'gro mar gyur pa ste 'khor bdud kyi lha sogs brdul ba dkar phyogs gnas pa'o/ / rdo rje dang ni byis pa'i ro/ / 'dzin pa byis pa'i gdon bco lngar gtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gtso mo yin pa'i phyir ro/ / ro langs ma shi ba slong ba'i lta stangs cung zad gyen du lta ba ma yi g.yas dang g.yon na'o/ /sbos mo dbugs 'byin gyi lta stangs phyogs bcur lta ba g.yon mi ro g.yas/ rgyu ma lus srul po mo la dbang ba'i brda' 'dren par byed/ / pa'o/ / za nus ma gar gyi lta stangs g.yas g.yon res kyi lta ba/ rdo rje dang thod pa bsnams pa 'o/ / rigs bdag mo 'dul ba'i don du he ru ka'i sring mor bstan pa'o/ /g.yas snying dang g.yon snying gis bkang ba yi/ / dur khrod ma mo'i gtso mo yin pa'i brda'o/ / thod pas phyag brel ba dur khrod ma/ / ni nam g.yengs kyi lta ba'am/ phus 'debs par grags pa/ phyogs bcur myur bar lta ba'o/ /g.yul du 'gro ba'i srin mor 'dul ba'i brdar/ g.yas mi mgo dang g.yon mi ro'i lus 'dzin pa ni gtum mo <te ro ldad pa'i lta stangs steng 'og tu res kyis lta ba/> 'o/ / lnga pa snyen bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yoḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ snying po'o/ / khri'am 'bum mam bye ba zla ba/ ༈ 'dir 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma ni/ mā ma dang*/ zhing spyod dang*/ kun tu spyod ma gsum du 'du ste/ dang po ni yul 'khor du rgyu ba ni lus 'dzin pa 'tsho ba spangs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni yul chen nyer bzhi sogs na gnas pa phan gnod gnyis ka byed pa ste/

mi yul brten mi brten gnyis ka yod/ de gnyis ka la lha klu sha za gnod sbyin srin mo dri za sogs rigs thams cad yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ rigs sna tshogs yod kyang srin po rnams dang spyod yul gcig pa ste/ srin po yang rigs gsum/ de ba rak+ṣa pa/ yak+ṣa yak+ṣa pa/ brah+ma rak+ṣa pa'o/ /de dag las phye ba dang*/ rigs rus chos 'brang gi 'brel ba mang du yod par gda'/ dang po ni/ ming po gsum dang*/ 'jigs byed dgu lta bu/ phyogs skyong gi gnas brgyad dang ri rab kyi khong seng na gnas pa'o// gnyis pa ni mgrin bcu dang bum sna sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dge sbyong dang bram ze'i lus su ston pa rgya mtsho la gnas shing*/ yul kun tu rgyu ba/ sring mo bzhi'i 'khor ro/ /dang po dang spyod yul gcig pa ma mo bdun nam brgyad lta bu/ gnyis pa dang gcig pa/ ral ba gcig ma dang*/ re re ba ti la sogs pa/ gsum pa dang gcig pa ni/ dus bzhi'i lha mo dang*/ sring mo khrung khrung ma la sogs pa'o/ /de dag mi'i lus brten pa'ang yod mod/ phal cher ma yin no/ /de thams cad he ru kas gdul bar bya ba thun mongs min pa'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dag pa'i zhing gi rnams la dbye ba nges pa med/ 'jig rten 'dir bzhugs pa ni zhi ba mo dang khro mo gnyis la 'khor sems ma 'jig rten las ma 'das kyang*/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma'i bya ba mi byed par 'jig rten 'das ma dang lhan cig spyod pa mang du yod de/ zhi ba mo ni bkra shis lha mo brgyad la sogs pa rnams yin/ khro mo ni 'dir smos/ gau rī sogs te 'di dag gong gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi lha dang*/ rgyal mo dang*/ ston pa mo'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /de dag gi dbang du byas te ci rigs par sbyar nas go dgos te/ de la drug pa las sngags ni/ oṃ e h+ye hi ru lu ru lu <sring mo rnams kyi sngags > dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dgug sngags

bh+yaḥ e a ral+li dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ḍā ki nī ā kar+ṣa ya <mkha' 'gro ma spyi'i dgug sngags > ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī nāṃ hṛ da ya hūṃ phaṭa dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ṭāk+ki hūṃ dzaḥ dgug pa'i sngags <te khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya > so/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+tan sa ma ya mu tra pra bhañdza ka hūṃ phaṭa/ zil gyis gnon pa'i sngags <te phyag rgya ni bya khyung gi phyag rgya bya ba'o//> so/ /oṃ ba ṭa ba mu kha ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣā ya to ṣā ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī nāṃ hṛ da yaṃ/ ha ha hi hi oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dbang du sdud pa'o/ / ni sngags te phyag rgya ni rdo rje khu tshur las mthe'u chung sbrel 'dzub mo rtse sprad pa dpral bar zlog pa/ bdun pa he ru ka mchod pa'i bya ba ni/ gtor ma la thabs shes kyi rdzas

sha chen dang bcas pa'i myos byed dang lha min dang 'byung po'i don du ba glang sha / dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rdzas/ khrag dang bcas pas he ru ka mchod na/ /he ru ka dgyes pas dngos grub mchog / 'grub te/ gnas dur khrod chen por stsol bar mdzad/ / do/ /shes rab kyi dkyil 'khor la rtsa rgyud du sku'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i kha skong yang gsung pa/ / rdul tshon bri ba'i tshe ngos re la khru lnga lnga re khru ni nyi shu'i tshad kyis rtsig pa dang ldan pa/ /sku yi sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dbus su gtso mo'i gzugs brnyan dgod par bya/ /zhal bzhi gser gyi mdog lta bu/ / phyag rgyas bzhi rim pas rdo rje zhags pa dung g.yas 'khyil dang mda'// g.yon bzhi rim pas lcags kyu ut+pa la ser po'i sdong bu dang gzhu/ /de bzhin gdug la sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i dkyil dkrungs kyis bzhugs/ / yi ge bcu pa'i gdan las skyes/ /me tog ma dkar de bzhin du/ /spos ma gnag cing mar me ma/ / ser mo dri chab ma kha dog dmar/ / mo de rnams rang ming gi phyag mtshan can no/ /zhi ba mo'o/ / gnod mdzes ma nag po'am brtun shing dang rnam rgyal ma/ / dkar po'am 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ sgo bzhir lcags kyu <ma sogs bzhi ste drug po khro bo'o > la sogs dgod/ /yang <phag mo'am nag mo'i ting 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor > gsungs pa/ 'di'i man ngag kyang logs su shes so/ / hūṃ gi yi ges te sa bon las byung ba hūṃ zhes sgra 'don ma// rdo rje phag mo nag po'am rnam <la 'byor > parasgom/ / zhal gcig po/ rab khros phag gi gdong ldan ma/ / phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod pa lag na thogs/ / pa/ zhabs gar gyi rol <g.yon rkyang ba > ldan bsgoms par byas la/ /yi ge hūṃ gis sbyor ba ting nga ེ 'dzin dang ngag tu bzlas pas/ / gnyid stug gi 'od gsal ba <ra 'char ba > ni byed pa dang*/ /bgegs zhi ba dang rang gi lus kyi

nad rnams 'don cing 'joms pa'o/ / de yan kun rdzob lha'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ da ni don dam rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ston te/ de la chos rnams sogs 'og nas ston <ste don dam dbyings pa > 'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / thabs rigs lngas so sor phye ste gsungs pa las/ rnam snang gis gsungs pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes gsungs pa ste/ chos rnams <kyi > rang bzhin yul dus bya ba kun gyis 'gyur ba med// <pa > dbyings 'di yi ngo bo ye shes rdo rje <'od gsal ba 'jig rgyu med pas/> rtag / spros pa thams cad/ gzod < ma > nas zhi ba yul yul can gnyis su med/ / pa ni/ nam mkhar nam mkha' la bzhag pa ji lta ba'o/ / sgrib gnyis 'joms pas dpa' bo chen po rnam snang 'khor lo'i rdas mtshon pa rig < te lha > pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / 'grel ba chung bar tsakra tsa la kra ma brda g.yo ba rim pas bcings pa dang*/ 'grel chen na tsā la krārta g.yo ba gnan pa ste gnyis ka la rlung 'gags pa'i don du 'chad do/ / zab pa spros bral dang dang rgya che <ba ji snyed mkhyen pa3gt; 'i rang bzhin no/ /chos rnams thams cad gdod nas ma skyes pa 'a ི / ngo bo/ / gzung ba yul dang 'dzin pa yul can gyi ngo bo rnam par spangs/ / pa/ gang zhig kun rdzob kyi chos rnams sgyu ma <lta bu3gt; 'i rang bzhin can/ / te me long ye shes kyi rnam pa'o/ / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje 'dzin pa mi skyod pa sa badz+ra bā dzu rā dza te mang po gsal ba shes bya thams cad gzigs pa la 'grel pa gnyis ka 'chad do/ / de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / bdag gzhan che chung sogs gnyis chos kyi chos rnams thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ / du gzigs pa/ gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med cing ming dang rgyu mtshan gyi gnas pa med/ / pa/ so sor 'byed chos dbyer med cing brjod pa 'i yul dang bral ba/ /sems can rang bzhin dag pa ra mthong bas snying rje dmigs med skye ba'i rgyu can/

/ no te mnyam nyid kyi dmigs pa'o/ / dpa' bo chen po rdo rje nyi mas <rin 'byung gi > sur+ya la samatā/ urta ma ra ta ya te/ mchog mnyam dga' byed de chos dbyings mchog tu rang gzhan mnyam pas sems can dga' bar byed do/ /zhes 'grel par ro/ / de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'di ni bde <ba > chen po'i ye shes dam pa ste/ / yon tan gsar du 'phel <ba > dang skyon gsar du 'bri ba yod pa ma yin/ / <la/> kun rdzob rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam par 'phrul ba/ /thams cad rten cing 'byung ba <sor rtog gi dmigs pa'o/> / tsam du mkhyen pa 'o/ /dpa' bo chen po 'jig rten lo tsā na ga ti/ mthong bas 'gro ba ye shes mig gis shes bya kun la 'gro ba la dbang 'byor bas dbang phyug tu gnyis las 'chad do/ / dbang phyug <'od dpag med > gis de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bden pa <ra blos gzhag tu yod/> ma yin te phung khams sogs su grub pas phyir ro/ / brdzun par gzhag tu yod pa min te ye shes rnam pa thams cad pa blo las 'das shing 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos/ / <pa'o/ /> 'gro <ba > 'di thams cad rang bzhin rnam par dag pa yang dag pa/ /ji ltar chu dang chu rlabs bzhin/ / du chos dbyings kyi cho 'phrul tsam mchog tu gdod ma nas sgrib gnyis dag pa gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa'o/ / <bya sgrub kyi dmigs pa'o/ / > gzigs nas 'gro don mdzad pa'o/ / dpa' bo chen po ral gri'i dam <khaṭ+ga la kha ṭa ma/ ra gā mi/ nam mkha' 'dus pa 'joms pa ste tshogs pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid las mi 'da' bas dam tshig gi rgyu gnyis las 'chad do/> /rigs kyi dam tshig gis <lha don grub kyi > de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / shes rab btsun mos bsdus te gsungs pa las zhus lan gnyis las zhus pa ni/ de nas rdo rje snying po sogs/ /sngags kyi dpa'o/ / rnams bzhengs shing phyag 'tshal te/ /dam tshig mkhyen pa chen mo sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma/ / dkyil 'khor gyi

gtso mo che la 'di skad zhus/ /e ma ho chos rnams ni ngo mtshar ba las byung ba/ / te/ nam mkha' nam mkha'i rang bzhin <du bzhag pa ltar/> spros bral chos spros bral rgya dang bcas pa rgyu 'bras rten 'brel las/ /sna tshogs chos kun 'byung ba ni/ /rdo rje rgyal mo zhes bos nas rgyu mtshan ci zhig lags/ /nyon la lan la mdor na cig rdo rje zhes bos nas don ji bzhin ma 'khrul bar nyon/ / cig gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu lta ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad stong nyid du bstan/ / pa kho na mdzad do/ /don du ni thams cad la chos nyid yongs grub kyis/ stong pa ma yin kun btags kyis mi stong min/ / pa'o/ /'grel pa gnyis las med pa dang yod pa'i rnam rtog gi yul min pa'o/ /rgyas bshad dang po snang ba sems ni/ thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i bag chags kyi mthu la sa/ /sna tshogs pa'i zhing khams snod kyi 'jig rten dang dbang po lnga dang*/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ro dang ldan pa/ / dang*/ / dri dang reg bya dang ni lus/ / kyi khog pa dang*/ / phyi don du snang ba dang nang don du rnam par gnas pa/ /thams cad rang sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ / yul nye bar dmigs pa la 'byung ba bzhi rnams dang gzungs sogs yum med de/ /sems nyid kyi dri ma phyi rol du snang ba'o/ / gnyis pa bden pa gnyis su dbye ba ni/ kun rdzob 'jig rten snang ngo ru tu ni 'jig rten 'di dag yod/ /dam pa'i don du ni dbyings las gzhan 'jig rten 'di dag med// gang gzung 'dzin gnyis snang thams cad med pas nang gi sems nyid bde ba dam pa rang rig pa 'i / / ye shes/ shes pa rang nyid gsal ba'i dngos po 'di kho na/ / tsam zhig yod do/ /༈ gsum pa spros bral du gtan la phab pa ni/ don du srid med ste 'khrul snang yin pas so/ / mya ngan 'das pa med/ / de don dam par mya ngan med cing de las 'das par snang ba yang brdzun pa yin pas so/

khams bco brgyad med rnam par shes pa brgyad med/ / la dngos po med cing yul can sgom pa med/ / rgya mtsho la rlabs dang gzugs brnyan dang srog chags dang*/ rin po chen sna tshogs kyi gnas yin yang*/ des ma gos pa ltar/ kun brtags lta bu brtags yod/ gzhan dbang lta bu/ srog chags dang 'dra na/ rdzas yod kyis ma gos shing*/ de thams cad 'char du rung bas na/ rgya mtsho lta bu 'i chos nyid/ de bzhin nyid/ / 'di ni sdig dang bsod nams kyi bya ba las 'das/ / pa te de'i 'bras bu min la/ gcig dang du ma'i dngos po gang yang kyang min/ / bzhi pa log rtog gol sa bcad pa ni thams cad kyi don dam pa'i dngos po ro gcig tu gyur pa 'i / / mtshan nyid can te/ gnyis med kyi ye shes gcig nyid dngos po thams cad la rnam par spros/ / pa ste thams cad la chos nyid kyis khyab pa'o/ / sdug bsngal bde ba yul rnam shes/ /kun las 'das pa'i ye shes bde chen po/ / 'di la rang ngos nas bya ba med cing byed po med/ / la las kyang med pa'o/ /rang bzhin la gnyis snang gang gis kyang ma dkrugs la rang bzhin glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa'o/ / rang bzhin de bde ba yin na/ chags pa'i bde ba yin nam/ chags bral gyi shin sbyangs pa yin nam/ dbu ma stong nyid mthong bas bde ba yin nam zhe na/ rang bzhin don dam 'di la 'dod chags med cing chags pa gdod nas med pas bral rgyu med/ / la/ dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur te 'di tshor ba ma yin cing dngos po'i gnas lugs yin pas dmigs rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ / don dam pa'i 'dod chags chen po'i gnyis med ye shes 'di yod pa sa/ / bde chen sgoms pa na chags ldan rnams la byang chub bde chen gyi sku ster/ / ro/ /gsum pa don bsdu ni/ 'khor ba ni sems nyid kyi snang ba ste phyi rol dngos po ra grub pa med/ / la/ sems las gzhan du mya ngan 'das pa byang chub kyang yod pa ma yin/ / no/ / srid pa dang zhi ba

'di gnyis ka don dam pa'i ro dang bral ba snying po bden par med/ /rang sems chos kyi dbyings/ bde chen don dam snying rje'i bdag nyid chos thams cad kyi mgon du don dam gyi skabs 'dir yod/ / do/ /rtsa ba'i don gnyis pa rgyud kyi sbyor ba rgyas pa la/ dang po rgyud ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa dang mtshan tha dad pa thams cad kyi sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba 'byung ba/ mi bslu bas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ / gnyis pa rgyas pa'i lha nyi shu'i sgrub pa dang po sngags ni (1) oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ spyan ras gzigs kyi'o/ (2) / oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i'o/ (3) / na mo bha ga wa te me ru shi kha ra ku ṭa pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ me ru me ru mahā me ru ye swāhā/ shākya thub pa'i'o/ (4) / oṃ āḥmai tri ye hūṃ swāhā/ byams pa'i'o/ (5) / oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa dhiḥ 'jam dpal gyi'o/ (6) / oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dha war+dha ni swāhā/ sher phyin ma'i'o/ (7) / oṃ dzam+bha mo ha swāhā/ gser can sgrol ma'i'o/ (8) / oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re me dha naṃ de hi de hi swāhā/ nor bu 'dzin pa'i sgrol ma'i'o/ (9) / oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re saṇ+tā rā ṇi hrīḥswāhā/ dbang byed sgrol ma'i'o/ (10) / oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ ku ru kul+le'i'o/ (11) / oṃ badz+ra tsan+ṭa sarba duṣ+tan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag na rdo rje rtsa ba'o/ (12) / oṃ ni lām+ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ phyag na rdo rje pho nya'i'o/ (13) / oṃ dzaṃ dhi ka ṭha mahā ho ha ra sarba dha na p+saṭ+ṭo rat+no hūṃ dzuṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

gtso mo nor rgyun ma'i'o/ (14) / oṃ ma no ha ra ha ra/ oṃ aṅgu sha aṅgu sha hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bran mo nor rgyun ma'i'o/ (15) / oṃ ha ya gṛ ba hrīḥ.a haṃ a haṃ a aṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ khro bo rta mgrin gyi'o/ (16) / oṃ mahā ka la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa ma ma kar+yaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ legs ldan nag po chen po'i'o/ (17) / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ hri traṃ k+ṣaṃ dzaṃ hūṃ ha/ di byā rat+nau ga ba ri sha na/ ar pa ka da pa ya sha sa ma ya/ ma nu sma ya/ hrīḥhūṃ phaṭa/ dzam+bha la ser po'i'o/ (18) / oṃ maṃ di ri di ri tsaṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sha za mo ral pa can gyi'o/ (19) / oṃ gaṃ gā na pa ti ma ma rat+na sid+dhi ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga na pa ti swāhā/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i'o/ (20) / oṃ ga na baṃ ho yaṃ dzaḥg na baṃ hrīḥyaṃ dzaḥ byang shar tshogs kyi bdag po'i'o/ / gnyis pa lha'i rnam par bshad pa ni/ (1) nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas rkyang rol stabs kyis yang dag par bzhugs shing gnas/ / pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon pad+ma dmar po bsnams/ / pas yum la mkhyud pa/ gos dkar mo dmar mo gzhan yab dang 'dra ba yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom par bya/ / rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma ni g.yas gri (2) gug 'phyar ba g.yon thod pa khrag gang lag na thogs/ / nas thugs kar 'dzin pa phag mo rab khros mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams/ / pa/ khro tshul cher bstan yang srin mo'i cha byad ma yin par/ lha mo'i tshul can yin pas/ mdzes ma shing ya ba'i me tog mtshungs/ / par dmar ba/ g.yas rkyang gis/ g.yon pas lha mo dkar mo dang g.yas pas phyugs bdag mahā de wa zhabs kyis mnan/ / pa'o/ /jo bo g.yon rkyang du bzhed de gnad gcig yod gsung*/ (3) gser mdog mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kun rdzogs shing*/ / phyag gnyis

bdud 'dul gyi phyag rgyas sa gnon mnyam bzhag gis khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ /gau taṃ shākya thub pa byang chub chen por bsgom/ /mgo bregs rab tu byung ba'i cha byad kyis brtul zhugs chen po'o/ / byams pa ni (4) byang chub mchod rten spyi bor 'dzin/ / cing lha'i drang srong gi cha byad can/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog can dang ni g.yas mchog stsol ba'i phyag / ser po/ dong ka'i me tog ltar mdzes pa/ / rnam snang dbu rgyan du bya mi skyod sogs sangs rgyas bzhi mā ma kī sogs rig ma bzhi ra bcas te brtag / go / (5) mdog dkar po 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /ral gri glegs bam phyag na bsnams/ /lte bar

yi ge drug pa'i rab bsngags kyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug par bcas/ /gzhon nu'i cha byad kyi tshul can bsgom par bya/ / 'o/ / sher phyin ma ni (6) zla ba ltar dkar ba g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ / g.yon po tis mtshan pa 'i chu skyes bcas/ / bsnyen pas bsgoms bzlas byas nas sgrub pa'i dus shu dag dang bcas pas/ /skyur po ma blangs pa 'thungs pas zla ba drug gis blo gros ster/ / g.yas (7) rin chen bum pa g.yon rin chen snye mar bcas/ /gang gi lag na nyer gnas pa/ /gser can sgrol ma bsam byas nas/ / longs spyod yid bzhin nor bu'i sprin lta bu nyid du 'gyur/ /dpag bsam shing brten (8) cing g.yas de'i yal ga dang*/ / g.yon nor bu'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa ni/ / jo bo'i 'grel bar/ ljang khu ras phran 'chang sgrol ma/ zhes pa snang ba tshigs bcad 'grig pa sogs dgos par sems kyang*/ rgyud kyi rgya dpe gnyis na med cing*/ grub chen zhi ba yang med bzhed gsung*/ nyi ma ni mdog kyang ser por ram bzhed pas 'bru 'grel med kyang*/ 'di mi 'don par mngon/ gser gyi brag phug na gnas par bsam/ /nyi ma (9) 'char ka gsar ba'i mdog / g.yas lcags kyu g.yon ut+pal dmar po bsnams/ /sgeg pa'i cha byad 'chang brgyan du mas rnam brgyan pa/ /dbang du byed ma 'i sgrol ma bsam par bya/ (10) /dmar po phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ / dang po gnyis mda' dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa'i mchog / 'og ma gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu phyag na bsnams/ /ku ru kul+le bsam par bya/ / g.yas rdo rje (11) thugs kar gtod cing 'chang ba phyag rdor g.yon gdan gnon pa/ / sngo bsangs yid tsam khro ba ste/ /sgrub pos mdun du bskyed pa bzhag nas ni/ / mtshan brgyad po ni brjod par bya sa / / la zlas pa bya'o/ / nag (12) po cher khros pas mi sdug pa g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba can/ / de'i brla gnyis bar du mkha' lding gi rgyal po ni// dug can a dza ga ra

sbrul sbram chen 'joms/ / phyag g.yon sdigs byed lag na rdo rje bsgom/ / nor rgyun ma 'di gnyis kyi sgrub thabs kyang logs na yod do/ / mdog (13) bzang gser lta bu kā ma dhe nu'i 'dod ba/ / g.yas pi tsu ra 'bras ser po kha sngo ba gcig yod gsungs/ g.yon rin chen snye ma 'dzin/ / gter gyi bum pa zhabs sprad pa la gnas pa'i gnod sbyin mo/ / las byed marka ṭa spre'u ces bsam par bya/ /pad+ma (14) rā ga'i 'od dang mnyam/ / sangs rgyas zangs kyi kyo ba ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor bus gang ba can/ / nor rgyun ma ni rnam bsgoms na/ /nges par dbang du byed pa yin/ khro bo'i (15) rgyal po rta mgrin ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar las khyi gdong can gyi rdo rje lha mo mkha' 'gro ma rigs bzhi/ / yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma lha zhal gyis 'khyud pa/ bsgoms nas gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /gzi brjid mthu stobs rta mchog dpal nyid dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /yang na zhal gsum g.yas nag po dang dbus dmar po dang g.yon dkar/ / po'o/ /phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje dang dbyug to dang bcas pa ral gri/ / 'o/ /g.yon gsum thod pa zhags pa dang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba thal mor bcas/ / pa'o/ /sprul pa mkha' lding rgyal po mang po rnam par spro/ / ba'o/ /yang na phyag gnyis pa g.yas dbyug to 'dzin par byas nas/ / zhabs gnyis g.yas kyis klu rgyal nor rgyas dang g.yon tshangs pa bcas pa gnon cing gzir ba/ /bsgoms na sbrul gyis zin pa sogs kyi dug rnams bskyod pa dang*/ /sna tshogs las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ / legs ldan 'di'i sgrubs thabs logs su shes so/ /nag po ni mun (16) pa'i sku lus ltar nag pa khrag 'dzag pa'i zhal/ / g.yas ral gri ste gri khug g.yon thod bcas pa'i sha chen za ba/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ do shal mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan/ / pa sgoms shing*/ dug shing la byas pa'i sku la mchod par bya/ / 'o/ / dzam bha la (17)

ni nor 'phel ba sgrub pa/ /ser po g.yas bi dza pu ra 'dzin/ /ne'u le g.yon na bsnams par bsgoms byas nas/ /chu sbyin dbang po mchod cing bsgrub par bya/ / 'di yang logs su lta'o/ / rab dmar (18) thod pa'i gdan la gar stabs kyis gnas/ / pa/ g.yas cang te'u g.yon thod pa shas gang ba 'dzin/ / pa/ ral pa ldan ma bsgoms byas na/ / 'di sha za mo'i gtso bo yin pas/ sha za mo rnams mngag gzhug 'gyur/ / 'di tshangs spyod bud med dang ma 'brel bas bsgrub dgos gsung*/ zhal gsum dbus glang po (19) g.yas spre'u rgyal g.yon byi ba'i gdong gi gzugs/ / mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag dang po gnyis dgra sta dang la phug phyag na bsnams/ / 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang chang snod bsnams pa yi/ / phyag bar ba gnyis/ zhi ba la bum pa/ rgyas pa la ne'u le'i skyal pa/ dbang la mda' gzhu/ drag po la gri zhags bya zhes jo bo bzhed/ man ngag la yum la mkhyud pa yin no/ / phyag drug pa zhabs ni bzhi pa la/ / byi ba la g.yon rkyang gis bzhugs pa/ yang zhabs rgyab ma gnyis kyis yum la mkhyud par nyi mas mdzad do chung ma sna chen ma zhes bya/ phag gdong ngam/ lha zhal can/ rin chen 'dzin pas mkhyud pa/ yan lag lhag 'dra/ g.yog mor spre'u'i gzugs can bzhi/ bcas bsgoms nas/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po mdun bskyed du de ltar sgoms nas la du la phug sogs dang sha chang mngar gsum sogs kyis mchod par bya/ / maṇ+ḍal zlum po'i dbus su zla khams dmar po gcig byas la/ stegs bu'i steng du sku bzhag mdun bskyed gam las/ tshogs bdag glang chen gdong*/ rab dmar (20) mche ba gtsigs pa ni/ / phyag mtshan dang las sbyor skabs zhags pa lcags kyu'i rab sbyor ba/ / gnas gsum/ byin rlabs ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan/ 'di yis ha na da ha pa tsa ban+dha bigh+nan mā ra ya hūṃ brtags na bgegs rnams 'joms pa dang*/ / las bud+dhi puṣ+ti ku ru ye swāhā sbyar na

blo dang hriḥhriḥdzaḥdzaḥbā shing ku ru rarna sid+dhi dzaḥdzaḥbartags na dbang du byed pa yin/ / gsum pa sa bon gyi rim pa de nyid kyis hrīḥ 1 baṃ 2 hūṃ 3 maiṃ 4 dhiḥ 5 a 6 taṃ 7 taṃ 8 taṃ 9 hrīḥ 10 hūṃ 11 hūṃ 12 baṃ 13 hrīḥ 14 haṃ 15 hūṃ 16 dzaṃ 17 hrīḥ 18 gaṃ 19 gaṃ 20 zhes rnams so/ /༈ rtsa ba sa bcad gsum pa rmugs 'dzin he ru ka'i sgrub thabs ni/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i sbyor rnal 'byor la gnas pa bas tsan+dan dmar po la dzaṃ bha la'i sku byas/ 'gron bu rin chen sna lnga/ ras sna lnga rnams stegs bu la zangs gzhongs su bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs/ mdun du dzaṃ dang*/ baṃ las gnod gnas dbang po dmar po bi dza pu ra dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ gnod sbyin mo nor rgyun ma/ rang dang 'dra ba la 'jug pa bsams nas/ ye shes pa gzhugs pa dang*/ gtor ma phul la oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ye dha naṃ mi de hi ḍā ki ni dz+wā la saṃ bha ra swāhā/ zhes pa 'dis nyin rer lan brgya rtsa brgyad chu sbyin no/ / dzam+bha la rang la bstim/ rten rnams mi lpags kyi khug mar bcug bcangs/ khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba yod la/ min na'ang nor can du 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa phyag brgyad sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor ni sngon mo spyi dang mthun pad zla la ro/ /tāṃ yig dang ut+pa la'i ye shes las skyes pa/ / sku mdog dang zhal bzhi pa la sha yi mdog / ltar ljang ba phyag gnyis thugs khar ut+pal 'i phyag rgya 'ching ba can/ / lhag ma g.yas gsum na 'phreng ba dkar po dang mda' chen dang 'khor lo dang*/ / g.yon gsum na rgyal mtshan dang gzhu dang bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin/ / pa lhag ma spyi bo dang mtshungs pa lha mo sgrol ma bsam par bya/ / yan lag lhag ma rnams kyang byas/ rtsa sngags zlas pas 'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung bar 'gyur/ / snying ga nas 'jigs pa brgyad skyob lha mo spros nas so so'i bzlas pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bzla zhing mtshan brgya 'don gsungs/

lnga pa gtor chog la sngags ni/ sngags 'dis bza' bca' ror bcas 'bul/ / gtor snod bcu gcig tu bshams/ sgrol ma nyer gcig spyan 'dren pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ yang bcu bshams la 'bul 'jigs pa las nges par skyob/ nang nub 'bul gsungs/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa naṃ/ he he bha ga ba te mahā sa twā sarba bud+dha a ba lo ki te/ mā bi lam+ba mā bi lam+ba i daṃ bā ling gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sarba bi sañtsa re swāhā/ rdzas ni kha zas bzang dgu la/ zla ba khu ba nyi ma rak+ta sman dri chen dang dri/ / chu/ mar khu ni rkang te bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ go ku sogs sgron ma lngas bcas pa/ / de kho na nyid lha'i rnal 'byor sbyangs rtogs sbar ba'i rnal 'byor ldan pas te kha zas bza' ba dang*/ / tsa ru 'i bza' ston byed pa dang de bzhin du gtor ma 'bul bar bya/ / drug pa bum chog ni maṇ+ḍal pad 'dab brgyad pa/ bum pa spyi mthun du bshams bgegs bskrad/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par skyed/ baṃ las bum chu skyed der sgrol ma phyag brgyad ma skyed pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs bzung thag me tog phreng ba nas bzung*/ dmigs pa gzhan spyi dang 'dra/ bdag gam sgrub bya'i nad gdon zhi bar bsam la/ bar bar du mchod bstod gtor ma gsol btabs rnams yang yang bya/ thun bzhir phyogs skyong dang 'byung po dang bgegs gtor gtong sgrol ma'i gzungs rings kyis bum pa la/ / zhag bdun bzlas te mthar zhu ste nad pa la gos ngan pa zhig skon chu phal pas skrus/ kha shar du stan/ bgegs gtor btang*/ lha mo bzhi'i sngags kyis gtor ma sgron me can zhig btang*/ yung kar gyis sdig pa sbyangs ba bya/ khrus chu gos ngan yung me rnams bzhi mdo'am chu bor skyal/ yang na drug bzhi ldan bya/ de nas stegs bu la bzhag gos dkar po gon nas/ bkrus byab srungs gsum shis brjod byas na/ nad gdon nas thar bar 'gyur ro/

/ bdun pa mi dang mi ma yin gyi chom po srung ba ni/ chom rkun chings shig ces pa yi ge bcu pa la gdags mang du bzlas/ tso ra bcings par bsam la/ thig gu la mdud pa byas shing*/ shing bu shing te te zer ba smag shad 'dra ba gcig yod de la zor ba'am spu gri'i gzugs bcos la a yig 'bri/ de la bsngags la a zhes btags pa bzlas pas thogs te song ba chom po bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ / bdun pa phag mo rmi lam du zhal lta ba ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i bsnyen pa song nas/ las sgrubs kyi don du phag mo'i sngags 'bum bzlas te dkyil 'khor sin+dhu ras byug pa bum pa dang bcas pa byas la/ mchod gtor 'bul zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra na ra ka hriṃ khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa smra ba bcad de zhag bdun bzlas pa gyis rmi lam du zhal ston par 'gyur te yi ge logs su yod do/ /brgyad pa dbang byed sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ nyi ma 'char ka sogs kyi las tshogs te/ 'grel pa gnyis ltar na/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i snyen pa song nas/ slar yang de'i ro/ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i snyen pa song nas slar yang de'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas skar ma rgyal la dge ba'i las mchod rten dmar po rab gnas kyang byas la/ gro ga la tshes brgyad la 'dab ma brgyad la yi ge brgyad lte bar oṃ spel tshig hā rnams bris mu khyud la ā li kā li'i skor ba'o/ ut+pal gyi 'khor lo kha sbyor byas la/ mchod rten gyi bum pa 'i smad kyi cha ra bcug steng du/ sgrol ma dmar mo skyed nas 'og tu bud med kyi rdzas dang bcas pa'i ming bcas che ge mo dbang du gyis shig ho ces bskul ba dang bcas zhag bdun du ngag bcad de nyis 'bum sogs bzlas pas gang dbang du bya ba de 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ / 'di la'ang yi ge logs su yod do/ / dgu pa byams pa'i gzungs chu ni gong du bstan pa'i bsnyen pa song nas bum pa spyi dang mthun par bcas pa dkar dang srad bu'ang bzhag

bris sku dang sa ra'i po ti dang*/ byang chub mchod rten mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams la/ bdag mdun mchod bstod 'dzin pa'i gtor ma sogs byas nas bum pa la/ byams pa'i sngags kyis 'bum du bzlas pa'i chus 'khrud pa dang*/ sa dkar la 'bum bzlas te ril bu byas pa dang*/ bsrung skud byas pa de dag ni nad dang gdon las thar pa dang*/ mtshams med pa byas pa'ang ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro/ / bcu pa ku ru kul+le'i phyag bsnyan sgrub pa ni/ bdag bskyed ku ru kul+le'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas gtsang po'i chu zangs ma'i snod du blangs te mdun du bzhag nas chu'i steng de la a las zla ba la ma las nyi ma la krongs skyed kyis brgyan dang bcas pa'i gnod sbyin mo g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin par bu mo chung ngu'i rnam pa can du bsams nas/ oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa ya dha ra dha ra dhi ri dhi ri swāhā/ 'di bsnyen sngags oṃ dzam+bhe mo he hri da yaṃ war+dha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di las sngags/ bsnyen pa sum khri byas la/ nangs par sum brgya bzlas nas hub gsum mthungs te/ khrus byas na rgyal khams sam gang 'dod pa/ thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ / spyod yul la 'jug pa na bsnyen sngags bzlas so/ /bcu gcig pa ro langs ma'i cho ga ni khrag gam tsan+dan gyis maṇ+ḍal byas la/ lha mo bai ta li ser mo drag mo skra dmar po 'phyang ba sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin par mdun du bsams nas/ oṃ bai ta lī pu tra sid+dhi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas 'bum phrag bzhi bsnyen pa bya/ sha khrag gi gtor ma 'bul/ de nas bum sgrubs kyi chus skyes pa dang bud med dkrus/ mthung du bcug te bud med de nyid ro langs mar skyed/ gtor ma rgya cher btang bas srid 'chags shing rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /sarba dza ya/ dngul chur bcas pa la be ta le'i sngags stong*/ pu tra sing+nghi'i tshab tu a tra ban+dha zhes spel ba btab te/

rna ba 'i bu ga ra bzhag na mtshon gyis chod par mi 'gyur ro/ / bcu gnyis pa gdugs dkar sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid gdugs dkar mo dkar mo 'khor lo dang rdo rje 'dzin pa rol pa'i khro mo brgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs can can du bsgoms nas/ yan lag lhag ma 'dra ste rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can no/ / tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba bud+dhā a dhiṣ+ṭha nā a dhiṣ+ṭhi te sarba ta thā ga tā uṣ+ṇi ṣa si ta ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swāhā/ ces mi g.yo ba dang rdo rje phur bu spros/ gcod pa dang*/ phur bus 'debs pa/ phur bus 'debs par bsam la bzlas pas gzhan gyi byad stems dang ro langs kyi las 'jig cing

bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro/ / bcu gsum pa sa 'og gi dngos grub sgrub pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i lha lag na rdo rje dang gnod mdzes kyi rig sngags grub pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo ba'i rdo rje'am/ gnam lcags kyi rdo rje byas la sa tā la sid+dhi hūṃ phaṭa ces btags la bzlas pas rdo rje 'bar bar gyur nas sa 'og gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ srad bu la sogs pa'i lha min gyi 'khrul 'khor bcom nas lha min gnas kyi dpal gyi sgo'am/ sa 'og gi bu ga'i sgo phal pa rnams su 'jug ste/ lha min dbang po gdug pa can/ stobs can dang 'jam po gzhan len la sogs pas mchod par byed de 'di dag rgyas par ni ji ltar sa 'og gi rtog pa las bshad pa de bzhin no/ / < du sgrub po/ /bcu bzhi pa ya mā ris drag shul sgrub pa ni sgrubs thabs kyi cho ga spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sgrol ma'i dbang du byas nas mdun skyed dam/ spyir bdag skyed kyang rung zer > dpa' bo gshin rje gshed po ni/ / sku mdog nag po g.yas dbyug pa g.yon zhags pa bsnams/ / pa khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing*/ ma he la g.yon rkyang gis gnas pa bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ bzlas/ te bsnyen pa'o/ / mchod gtor sogs gshin rje gshed spyi sogs dang 'dra ba dang*/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa dang*/ so gnyis pa yang las kyi don du 'bum du bzlas la/ nang mar re mig dgu pa la sngags kyi khang pa lnga/ dang*/ bar ba/ khang pa bcu gnyis dag dang bcas/ / pa la ya sogs dgod/ de la hrīḥṣ+tīḥl sogs dag gis yi ge re re zhing bskor/ / lte ba dang re mig stong pa la ming spel te/ sgrubs na 'khor lo 'di yis drag shul spyod kun bsgrub/ / dgod bya yi ge ni yak+ṣe ma me da dza sa do ru/ ṇa yo ni ra yats+tsha ni ra/ / bco lnga pa 'byung po rnams kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa ni/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa sgrub bo/

/oṃ yo yak+ṣi ṇī bī ra dze swāhā/ shang leb la ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon gos sna tshogs 'dzin pa mo bris la de bkug te skye gnas su gzir bas bzlas na 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ / 'di man chad kyi sgrub thabs bcu gnyis la rgyud 'di nyid du sngags tsam las mi 'byung na yang gsang ba thig le las rgyas par gsungs pa ltar sbyor dgos te/ der drag pos dgos 'dir ma phye'o/ / 'ongs nas kyang ci bgyi byed par (1) 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bha ga wa te swāhā/ byang chub kyi shing la sogs par gzugs brnyan bya'o/ /gnod sbyin mo nor can gyi'o/ (2) /na mo bai shra ma ṇa/ ta ya na ḍa ku be rā ya/ dī bya bi ma na tsi ra ta ya/ he ma mā la kun+ṭa la/ sha ri ta ya/ yak+ṣa sa/ ban+dha ya t+t+waṃ bha ga wā na/ ā warta yi ṣ+ya mi/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ma ṇi ma ṇi kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ ku ku ku ku/ pa ra pa ra/ pu ra pu ra/ ku be ra ku be ra na ḍa ku be rā dī bya ma na kun+ḍa ku bi ku bi swāhā/ na ḍa mo yi'o/ (3) /oṃ na ḍa bi na ḍe dha ri ṇi swāhā/ na ḍa pho'i 'o/ (4) /yak+ṣa ki li ki lo na mo sat+t+ya ba di tiṭ+ṭa pra taḥ ta sha t+yaḥ paṇ+ḍi da da mi se ma ka mā na pra yats+tshan+tu swāhā/ ki li ki li'i 'o/ (5) /phuḥhaṃ phuḥ klu mo mtha' yas ma'i 'o/ (6) /oṃ hrīḥdza/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i 'o/ (7) /na mo bha ga wa te pi lu pa lā ya/ pi sha tsi/ saṅkha bhuṅga te/ sa me ka ma na/ pra yats+tshan+tu/ tad+ya thā/ hu lu hu lu/ pi sha tsa/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra da ba ra da/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsu ṭu tsu ṭu na maḥswāhā/ sha za pi lu ba'i 'o/ (8) /na mo bha ga wa te pi sha ya/ aṃ ka ka na pi sha tsa dha ri ma ni swāhā/ sha za nor bu 'dzin pa'i 'o/ (9) / oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa pi shā tsa ya sa ra sa ra sarba ar+tha na me swā dha ya swāhā/ sha za nag mo'i 'o/ (10) /a lu ke be le ke gṛh+ṇa baṇ+ḍa pi shā tsi ni swāhā/ e lu ka'i 'o/ (11) /oṃ kha ra mu kha pe shā tsi nī hi hi da da pa ya swāhā/ bong gdong ma'i 'o/

(12) /oṃ ta ti le ta ti le kṛṣ+ṇa mu khe mahā pi shā tsi de hi de hi da swāhā/ dus kyi gdong gi'o/ (13) / tshe ring sor byed pa'i rdzas ster ba dang*/ bcud len grub pa'i dngul chu sogs ri lu mig sman sogs/ / ster ba dang*/ 'gro ba pho mo kyang ring po nas 'gugs pa dang*/ / gzhan sems kyi byed pa dang*/ thag ring ba dang*/ sgrib g.yogs kyi lkog gyur shes pa rang la smra zhing*/ ston pa la sogs/ / dang*/ de bzhin du zas dang gser gyi 'dod pa nyin re bzhin ster/ / bar byed do/ /bcu drug pa mi g.yo mgon po'i dbugs dbyung ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das snying stobs nus pa ches phod pas shākya bdud bzhi thub pa de khros pa ni mi g.yo nyid des sprul pa'i khro bo yin pa'o/ / rdo rje gtum po mi g.yo ba spros pa ni/ sa bon hūṃ sku ni ral gri zhags pa phyag gnyis na bsnams pa'i mchog /skra ser brjes pa 'khrang la grims pa'i lus/ / rin po che'i cod pan sbrul dang rus pas brgyan pa g.yas kyi pus mo dang g.yon gyi zhabs mthil btsugs pa/ stag lpags kyi bsham thabs sogs grol grol ba'o/ /dgra bgegs thams cad gsod pas ma rungs pa khros pas gtum po cher 'khrugs pa/ / sku'i mdog nag po spyan g.yas gyen dang g.yon thur du gzigs pas/ mig yon po dgyes pa spro ba che/ / ba'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ thugs kha'i sngags las spros pa'i pho nya dang*/ me yis bgegs rnams sprod pa ra bsam pa skrod nus dang*/ /sngags bzlas chu yis srung ba'am/ / mtshan ma gtsang chu blangs la/ nam mkha' ma mthong bar bya/ snga dro chu de'i phyed kyis khrus bya/ phyed khyor ba g.yas su blug / g.yon pas mnye zhing sngags lan gsum bzlas la btung ba lan gsum bya/ sngags rtsa sngags su bzhed/ bod kyi chu srung la/ na maḥ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa ya/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa/ k+ṣaṃ traṃ tra sa ya/ k+ṣaṃ traṃ tra sa ya/ saṃ tra ya/

saṃ tra ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ 'phar ma gnyis pa'i 'khor lor nang ma zlum po la ral gri'i yu bar hūṃ mtha' skor yi ge bcu pa spel tshig can/ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ phyogs bzhir ral gri/ mtshams bzhir zhags pa rnams hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mu khyud la rtsa sngags 'dus pa nas 'byung*/ de spel tshig bcas bri/ de'i phyir gru bzhi sgo bzhi bya/ khor yug re mig nyer bzhi la le'u dang po'i mi g.yo ba'i rtsa sngags bgos la bri/ phyi rdo ra me ri can no/ /sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ nad gnod khyad par chos kyi bar chad srung ba'o/ / bris/ / yang na 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ lte bar hūṃ la oṃ de rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ rtsibs bcu la yi ge bcu mu khyud rim pa gnyis/ dang po la ā li phyi ma la kā li mu khyud nyid 'dab brgyad ma'o/ /ri bo'am dben par 'di yi smin drug yar ngo la zla mtshan gyi ras sam g.yul gyi ras la/ thun bzhir mchod bstod dang bcas/ bris sku byas nas ni/ / rab gnas mchod pa rgya cher bya'o/ / maṇ+ḍal mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas khro rgyal rtag tu gtor mas mchod/ / <rang gi dngos grub kyi don dang*/ nad pa'i rim gro/ lam gyi 'jigs pa sel ba sogs la ches bsngags/ bris sku 'jigs pa la zhal ston/> /lha dgu phyi rol tu phyogs skyong gi maṇ+ḍal byas la/ gtum po khro bo'i rgyud kyi/ gtor sngags la sogs kyi sngags btags/ kham phor du yungs kar blug gong gi 'khor lo chung bas kha bcad nyin bdun bzlas/ lag yungs kar brab pa dang*/ chu la yang cho ga yungs kar dang 'dra ba dang pu ta lis/ / ga snying gar ming dang dri zhes bya ba bris dgug gzhug mang du bya/ gong 'khor lo'i bar du bcug ste sar sgrubs/ bgegs rnams tshogs sogs pho nya spros pa'i tshogs kyis dmigs pa dang*/ tho ba skyed chog byas te brdung*/ tshin+dha'i sngags so/ /nas rkang du nas rdubs te lam rgya gram du mnan na/

nyams par byed pa gdon zug dang*/ chags che dang*/ sre'u ma sos pa dang*/ 'dre zhugs shing rlams/ thud la sogs pa zlog pa'o/ / dang*/ /dpung rnams gnon dang dbye ba sgrubs po bzhi ldan las mi nyung ngo*/ /gcig gis thun brgyad du gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'bul zhing sgrub po gcig gis sbyin sreg gcig gis gong gi bgegs 'dul gyis dgra bo'i lha skrad/ gcig gis seng lding gi phur pa la dur khrod kyi rus pa dang yungs kar btags che ge mo dang che ge mo bi dwiṣa ya phaṭa ces bris shing zlas/ dgra bo'i sgo gong sbas/ dmag yong phyogs su yungs kar u tsa ṭa'i spel gyis sdig go /yang na dbye ba ni/ gong gi 'khor lo che chung kha dang 'ug pa la gnas pa bri/ de'i sgro gnyis rta dang ma he'i rmig pa'i bar du btsug dgug gzhug sogs sgrubs te/ sgros sbyin sreg byas la bar du sbas so/ / dang*/ /bsad pa ni dug khrag gam lan tshwa dang ra bong bu'i khrag dang*/ sbang sha rus/ sha chen/ ba glang gi sha myos byed rnams dang*/ nag bra bo sogs sres pa'i sbyin sreg ling ga sreg pa sogs bya/ dgra'i zag rdzas la liṅga bya/ 'khor lo snying khar gzhug 'gug 'dren dang lha dbye drag tu bya/ thod par bcug bcings te yang sgrub dur khrod du sbas nas la sogs skrad pa dang ngag gnon ni rab bya ste/ / 'grel ba gnyis nas yungs kar chu khrag ste brag rdzas bgegs nyams ni dgra'i srung ba bshig pa dpung gnon pa 'jig rten pa'i lha dbye dang ni 'das pa'i lha dbye rnams byas la bsad skrad gnan dbye sogs bya zhes dang*/ 'khor lo dang gtor ma'i las gong du rtan/ bris dus sgrub pa stan te las tshogs gcig tu bzhed do/ / gtum po khros pa'i rgyud mi g.yo bla med du grags pa dang gtum po yi/ /dam tshig 'byung ba rgyud rgyal po rang bla med yin pa las tshogs gtso bor ston pa gcig ste bod na ni med la sogs par/

/ mi g.yo rgyal po nyid kyis gsungs/ / pa bzhin gtso mo sgrol mas 'dir zur tsam gsungs so/ / sngon tshe skal pa bzang po la ri rab kyi rtse mo'i bdag po/ lha mo bde ldan te rdo rje phag mo'o dang*/ /sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs mi skyod pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul bar bzhed nas 'dus pa las/ / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshul gyis sgrol ba'i bdag dang ming po mi g.yo btsas/ / te sprul lo/ /gling bzhir dgra bcom gtso bo bzhi po rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ / 'dod lha bdud sdig can dang lha min rnams kyis nyams byas// de nas lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par gyur pa'i tshe/ /mi g.yo mgon gyis lha min gyi dbang*/ po rgyal po/ khrag khrig bcu gnyis ral gris rab tu gtubs nas/ / tshar bcad de/ de de'i chung ma kun la 'dod pas rjes su tshags par byas/ / te lam la bkod do/ /ngan phyogs kyi mi dang dri za dang mi'am ci / / dang*/ gnod sbyin dang klu gdug pa rnams kyang srog bcom ste/ / bsad pa thams cad rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du te mngon dga' la 'phangs/ / te/ /de dag kun gyi ming yang byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs rgyal/ / po sha stag go /de dag sngon byung ste rjes 'jug mi g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ mi la mngon spyod kyi las dang*/ mi min gzir ba'i las dang khyad par bdud dang*/ lha min 'dul ba'o/ / mi g.yo ba chags chen gyi ye shes 'phel bar gyur pa yis/ /sring mo sgrol ma dag dang ma lha mo bde ldan yang bsten/ / pa na/ phyag rgya mo mchog de'i rgyus/ bde ba'i nang nas kyang bde ba lhan skyes bla na med par thob ste bde ba mchog de yis/ / sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas spangs nas sangs rgyas mi g.yo mgon por sangs rgyas par gyur/ / ro/ /de dag mngon byung yin la/ rjes 'jug ltar na/ lha min mo dang mtshungs pa'i phyag rgya nges can sbyangs pas byung ba la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skyes par byas/

mi sogs mtshungs pa spyod pa spyad pas de brtan can 'phel bar byas/ sgrol ma nyid dang mtshungs pa nye rgyu bsten pa yin no/ / mi g.yos gling bzhi'i dgra bcom par rnams la smras/ / pa/ bud med dmad cing spangs pa'i spyir sku gsung rdo rje la rmad bye brag lha mo'i rigs la smad pa'i sdig pa 'byung la de las/ /shes rab spangs shing bde ba'i rgyu la smod cing spangs pas stong nyid spangs par 'gyur te/ de rtogs pa bde ba la rags las so/ /des na/ bde ba'ang spangs pas/ / na sems can bde ba la bkod mi thub cing stong nyid ma rtogs na snying rje yang phul phyin mi 'byung bas/ snying rje shin tu stobs dman par byas/ / pa yin te bdag mtshungs kyi byams pa spangs shing bud med la smad pa gnyis kyang sems can gyi phyed spangs pa dang*/ dman par zhen na stong nyid rtogs pa'i gegs kyang che'o/ / gang zag gang shes rab dang snying rje gang dag spangs pa/ /'dis ni de'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang de'i rang bzhin dam chos dang*/ / de la spyod pa dge 'dun yang ni smod cing rnam par spangs pas/ / dmigs pa can gyi dge slong gang dag bud med la smod par byed pa/ / ni/ so sor thar ba ltar na/ bud med rab tu 'byin pa sogs rjes su bzung ba dang yang 'gal/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems skyed ltar na sems can blos spangs par sogs/ sngags ltar rtsa rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba sogs mang bas na sdom pas dman zhing sdig pa dang bcas/ / pa'o/ / bud med dang sbyor las thig le dbab zlog goms na thig le 'dzag med 'grub pa'i phyir sdom brtson nyid/ / che mchog tu gyur pa gzhan ni phyag rgya'i lam la ma goms pas ni tshangs spyod la gnas pa ltar byas kyang*/ rmi lam sogs su thig le 'dzag pas na tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa'i tshangs spyod rnam dag med pa'i phyir/ /mgo bregs ngur smrig gi cha lugs can mong zhig tshangs spyod med kyang yod do zhes

sgyu mas te g.yo sgyus 'jig rten bslu/ / te mi tshangs spyod srings pa tsam la tshangs spyod du rdzu bas so/ /dgra bcom khyed cag mā ma ki sogs sring mo'i 'phags ma rnams dam tshig rig ma rten par gis/ / shig de tshe gling bzhi na chos ston par gnas pa 'i dge slong gi gtso/ / bo bzhi po bud med phyag rgya'i dam tshig las bde ba chen po ye shes thob pa yis/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur/ / te/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs sangs rgyas bzhir rab tu grags/ / so/ / rjes 'jug sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor la mi skyod yab yum spyi bor sgom rigs bzhi yum bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan no/ /bskal pa bzang po'i dus 'dir ming po mi g.yo ba gau taṃ thub pa ste/ / bu mo go pā ni sring mo sgrol ma bdag / yin la/ rig 'dzin lha'i bud med brgyad khri'i

dang phyi nang gi 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa'i bde ba yis/ /longs spyod chen po dang bcas pa'i khyim du sa bcu thob/ / pa'i tshul stan te spros bcas kyi spyod pa'o/ / de nas rab tu byung nas zhing du rgyu zhing kun 'dar gyis/ /spyod pa yongs su spyod pa na/ /'jig rten pa rnams 'di drang srong rnams dang lhan cig kun tu rgyu zhes rtog / go / de nas dka' ba spyod par mthong ba ni/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa'o/ /zhes shugs la thob gsung ngo*/ /grong ba'i bu mo dga' mo dang ni dga' stobs ma ra / / sprul pa'i lha mos 'o thug phul bar mthong ba'i tshe/ zas mchog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug gi bde ba yis/ / mtshams sbyar rdo rje'i gdan la sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur te rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa nyid/ / do/ /byang chub snying por gzhug pa'i tshe/ mi g.yo ba khros pas bdud 'khor bcas thams cad bsad skrad sogs kyis bcom nas/ /bdud kyi bu mo rab bkram gyi grangs tsam rnams/ /'dod chags chen po spyad pas bde chen gyi lam la bkod nas rjes su bzung / / ngo*/ /des na drag shul spyod pa dang bde ba'i lam 'khrig sbyor las/ / gzhan du byang chub kyi lam zab mo gzhan yod pa min yang*/ / dus de'i tshe/ skal med mang po phal pa'i chags sdang la sred pa ma gtogs/ chags chen la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thun mong gi snang ngor med pas na/ blo chen rnams chags bral dang byams pa la/ /mos pa'i phyir rgyal bas bdud rnams byams pas brtul shing chags bral lam las sangs rgyas thob par mthong ba'i sgyu ma sprul pa mdzad/ / do/ /'di'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i dam tshig ni bud med sgrol ma bdag sgrub pa de yis ni/ / rdo rje ming po la sogs pa spyi dang 'dod pa'i bde bas mnyes par bya/ / la/ mi g.yo rgyal po'i dam tshig gis/ / ni/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhig rdo rje sring mo dang*/ / rdo rje bu mo

dang rdo rje ma yang mchod pa spyi dang gsang bas mchod par bya/ /yugs sa mo zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten na sngon khyo can phyis khyo med du gyur pa ni brda ste/ de ni bud med gang*/ sngon thig le 'dzag pas thig le 'dzag med du gyur pa'o/ /de kun bde ba yis/ /dga' bar byas na mi g.yo mnyes/ / par 'gyur la cung zad ye shes brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'di dag thams cad sgra ji bzhin par spyod pa yin no/ / mi gang nga la mchod byed pa/ / de la gtum mo la mchod kyang khro bo gtum pos byin gyis rlobs/ / par 'gyur la de bzhin du gtum mo mchod pa yang mtshungs so/ / mi g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor sprul/ gdul bya grangs med pa byang chub la gzhol pa'i dbugs dbyung ba <stan tshul/> 'o / / bcu bdun pa 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs kyi sgrubs sam sngags ni oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba bha ya sha ma ni sarba durga ti tā ra ṇi tu re swāhā/ seṅge la sogs gcan gzan thams cad/ bsrung ba 'i <sngags te > 'o/ / lha ni nag mo seng ge'i gdong 'khor lo dang me dpung bsnams pa'o/ / oṃ dī ra da/ ba da ni e ka daṃṣ+tī mahā na se lam+bo dha ri kar+dha kar+dha drā sa ya drā sa ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ glang po che la sogs pas ma he la sogs pa phyugs thams cad bsdus te/ de rnams kyi 'jigs pa bsrung ba 'i < sngags te/ lha ni dud ka bsus 'phyang glang chen gdong pa mche ba gcig pa g.yas ral gri g.yon shar du la rnams pa3gt; 'o/ /oṃ shi khī ba da ne mahā u ka la mu khī/ dz+wa la mā li ni sap+ta dzi n+wī/ sap+ta mu khī bi shwa na rī tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ me'i 'jigs pa bsrung ba 'i 'o/ / <sngags te/ lha ni dmar po drag mo zhal bdun ljags bdun skyod pa nor bu dang chu'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ / > oṃ pha nī mahā pha ni kṛṣ+ṇa ne tre e ka da na dzi hwī ka re ṇa/ tsa lā ya tsa lā ya mahā bi ṣa bhak+ṣi ni tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/

dug thams cad sbrul la sogs pa khung bur gnas pa'i srog chags kyi 'jigs pa la skyobs pa'i las bsrung ba'i <sngags te/ lha ni dkar mo yid tsam khros pa sbrul nag po'i mgo bo bdun dang ldan pa sbrul brgyad can phyag drug bum pa dang sbrul zhags nor bu sman gyi dbang po'i snod rnams 'dzin pa3gt; 'o/ /oṃ kharga hasti bhṛ ku ṭi mu khi ur+dha ke sha mahā na dhi kṛṣ+ṇa añdzan bhar+ṇa tshin+da tshin+da bhin+da bhin+da ut+ta ra ya ut+ta ra ya tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ chom rkun la sogs pa mi 'gro ba'i gnod pa bsrung ba'i <sngags te/ lha mo ni cher 'khrugs pa skra rdzes pa phyag drug ral gri dang mdung dang dgra sta dang*/ mda' gzhu phub chung bsnams pa'o/> 'o/ /oṃ rak+ta war+ṇe pā shāṅku sha hasti ma hā ra wi/ mahā ba la sa ra sa ra bi sa ra bi sa ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ā kaṭaḍha ā kaṭaḍha mahā durga na mu tsā la tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ lcags sgrog dang zhags pa sogs dang rgyal po'i chad pa sogs thams cad las skyob pa' ི <sngags so/ /lha ni dmar mo zhi ma khro/ / phyag brgyad g.yas bzhi lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon bzhi zhags pa bsnams pa3gt; 'o/ /oṃ dza le dza le mahā dza le tā ra ya tā ra ya ut+tā rā ya ut+tā rā ya/ shṛṅkha la hasti mahā dza we e ka bi ri mahā ka ru ṇe tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ chu las skyob mi'i <sngags te/ lha mo sor mo phyag gnyis ma ri rab dang*/ sa yi dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/ nor bu me 'bar ba phung po la gnas pa3gt; 'o/ /oṃ mahā gam+bhi rar+yai mahā kā ru ṇi ke bha ga waṃ bā le bha ra dha a bha yi hasti tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ sha za sogs gdon thams cad las bsrung ba 'i sngags te/ lha mo dkar mo phyag bcu pa dang so gnyis skyabs sbyin dang chos 'byung*/ lhag ma brgyad dang*/ zhabs bcu ni gdon bco brgyad la sdigs pa'am/ 'dzin cing gnon pa ste gdon bco brgyad stong chen rab 'joms ltar bris so/

/ bco brgyad pa las tshogs phra mo sna tshogs pa ni/ bdag skyed gtor ma btang ba sogs byas la/ skyes pa la gur yum/ bud med la gi haṃ gyis dar ram/ ras la 'o/ /'khor lo bris rtsi ljang khu btang rtsibs brgyad pa/ / lte ba dang mi khyud rim bdun/ dbus su taṃ la oṃ/ bsgrub bya dgod par bya/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni tā nas swā'i bar yi ge brgyad/ /sngags kyi grong khyer ā li kā li bdag pos hūṃ gi bskor/ / man ngag gi mu khyud nang ma la ye dhar/ gnyis pa rdo rje'i phreng ba/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥha che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ gsum pa la ā li kā li/ bzhi pa la 'khyil ba'i gzungs/ lnga pa la ral gri taṃ gi mtshan pas/ drug pa la hūṃ 'ba' zhig bdun pa la me dpung ste/ bris nas 'khor lo rab gnas 'dra/ rin po che'i snod du zhag bdun sogs sgrub cing mchod/ sgrol ma zhu nas tāṃ yig tu gyur/ dril te rin po che'i snod du bcug skyes pa'i g.yas/ bud med kyi g.yon nam/ mgul du btags so/ /'khor lo kha dog ljang khu bris zlas sgom gsum gyi sa bsrung bar 'gyur ba ste/ / yid bzhin 'khor lo sgom pa'ang 'dis zin nam sel mod/ 'chi ba bslu byed la kha dog 'od zer dkar po dang spel tshig spos pa/ 'khor lo sgoms pa dang*/ bris pa dang*/ 'dod chags pa dang*/ mchod pa la sogs pa'i phan yon ni 'o/ /nad zhi ba dang brtson las thar pa dang*/ /tshe 'phel ba dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ / che zhing yid gzhungs pa/ dbang phyug te dbang thang rgyas pa dang ni blo gros shes rab 'phel/ / bar 'gyur ro/ /yar ngo'i tshes gsum sogs dus bzang po la gza' skar dge ba la tshwa la gi haṃ dri chu dang*/ / phug pa kha byang bstan gyi gting du khru gang brkos pa'i sa dang tsi tra ka dang dpa' bo/ / te btsan dug dang*/ gla rtsi dang me'i ro tshan cha mnyam pa'i ril lu sran ma tsam yis/ /dug rnams srung bar byed pa

thun bzhi zhag bdun sgrubs nas/ dug gis ma zin pa la lto stong la lan re zos pas zla re srung zin pa la dug sman du 'gyur ste/ / ril bu rin po che'i snod du bzhag sgrol ma rang 'dra skyed zhu ba las ril bu bdud rtsir sgom/ brgyad stong thun re la zlas/ bza' ba'i tshe yang gong ltar/ bzlas pa dang 'khor lo bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bya/ /paṇ+ḍi ta bla sgang li kha thur yin no/ / kar yi rtsa ba dang*/ / rtsa ma zos gong gi be'u'i <gci > lc-i bas sres pa'i ril bu dug rengs srung bar byed/ / mu khyud rim gsum lte ba dang bcas pa rtsibs ni bcu drug pa/ / dbus su sgrub bya'i gzugs/ /de'i mthar ku ru kul+le'i rtsa sngags las sngags dang rtsibs te/ de la yang rtsa sngags las sngags kyi sham bu can bris te/ kyis dgang*/ 'khor lo kha sbyor rgya skyes dang rkang rjes bsres pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi khog tu gzhug sbyor ba bya/ /zangs ma'i khab kyis gzugs brnyan de'i gsang gnas phug / lan tshwar bcas pa'i rang gi gcin gyis ling kha de'i kha bkang nas/ /rgya shug gi shing gi me la gdung shing spro bar bya/ / sbyin sreg kyang bya/ pho mo'i dmigs pa so sor bya/ de nas sngags me tog la btab nas sgrub bya la bsnun pa dang zas sres te ster ba dang spos/ / dang sres te bdug pa dang*/ mig sman sbyor bas dbang du bya/ / bud med kyi thod pa dum bu gsum par tshil chen dang arka'i bal gyi mar me tshes brgyad dam nyer dgu'i nub mig sman sgrub pa'o/ / sgrol ma dkar mor lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsam zhing sgom par byas nas/ / ngag bcad de mi smra bar ni 'bum bzlas so/ / bsnyen pa'o/ / sangs rgyas rtag pa'i rnam snang gi sbyor las byung*/ / ba ste rigs bdag go /mdun skyed gtso bo sgrol ma dkar mor bya/ yid gzhungs ma sogs smṛ ti/ pradz+nyī/ bud+dhi/ swa bha ba re 'khor bzhi dang bcas/ / par sgoms nas zla ba phyed sgrub cing mchod do/

/ser po khrag rkang halat+ya li dang ra dang zi ra/ / dkar nag dang*/ grog sman si ling dang*/ sha pho ru rta dang la la phud/ / dang*/ ra yi 'o ma dang ra'i mar khur bcas btung*/ / bar bya'o/ /yang na shu thag dkar po dang*/ halat+yai'i gong bzhin sngags bzlas te 'di dag dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag zhag bdun sgrubs te zos na/ /'dis ni blo gros 'phral du 'phel bar 'gyur/ / ro/ /tho rangs maṇ+ḍal du yan lag bzhi rdzogs skyaid mchod bstod gtor ma yan lag bdun pa rnams byas nas sgrol ma'i phyag g.yas mi 'jigs rgya/ / rang gi spyi bor reg pa <ra bsam > sa la dngos su phyag rgya de spyi bor gtug pa chom rkun sogs 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung*/ / shing btson las kyang thar bar byed gsungs/ gu gul dkar po dang dā la'i 'dab ma dang*// sha pho ru rta dang gla rtsi dang dpa' bo ste dug dang sbyar/ / la ril bu bya/ yang na shu thag dang shing kun sbyar ba las/ /ril bu ste de gnyis sngags spel chig can 'bum bzlas nas za bar bya/ / 'o/ / dri chu gla ba 'i chu la yang 'bum bzlas te dpral mgrin snying lte gsang ba de sa gnas lngar srin lag gis byug cing rkang pa la yang byas bsrung*/ / ba bya/ zla ba drug gis mdze nad gso bar byed pa'i mchog / go /bu ma skyes pa'i rang byung gi me tog bh+rid+ga rā dza 'i khu bar bcas/ / zla ba drug tu sna yis rngubs na rgas pa sel/ / la/ lo gsum du thun bzhir bud med sbyor ba la brten te yis/ khu ba bkag cing khyab par byas pas rgas pa med par gzhon nur byed/ / rna ba 'on pa'i rna bar dug dang nā le sham/ / ras bal gyis dris la bcug ste lo gcig lon pas phyis de bcug pa'am btags pa'i chus gzhan gyi rna ba 'on pa sel/ / phyi'i rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dngos dang rgya mtsho'i 'bras/ / zer ba'i shing 'bras dang*/ ra 'i gcin dngos sbyar ba mig nad phal cher 'joms/ / bgo nad srung ba ni oṃ sum+bhi ro dha na ye swāhā/

sngags brgya brgya bzla'o/ / koṣ+ta'i rus pa ste mdze rus dang bya rog gi mig / dang*/ gser gyi phye ma'i phur mas bza' phog lta bu'i 'bog nad bsrung*/ / sgrol ma dkar mo'i snyen pa sngon song gi sgrubs pa'i skabs/ khru gang las mi chung ba ba'i lci bas byugs pa'i dbus su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dbus su lcags kyu dza yig gis mtshan pa dang ldan par bya/ / phyi ru me tog dkar po'i tshom bu lnga bkod/ mchod bstod gsol btab phyag 'tshal nyer gcig mang du brjod/ slar bzlas pas bdag skyed lha mo'i thugs kha'i dza las lcags kyu spros btson 'don par bsam/ khri bzlas na btson las thar bar 'gyur/ / te las sbyor skabs smra ba bcad sngags rgya re la mchod bstod gsol btab ste bya ba mtshan thog thag bya'o/ /yung ba haltigi haṃ kas+thu ri 'i / / khu bas/ rtsa sngags bris pa bum par gdags byas la/ / bum sgrub pa cho ga bzhin du bya/ nyin thog thag snying po bzla/ mtshan mo rtsa sngags bzlas la/ nam gung sbrum ma ku sha'i gdan la bzhag nas bgegs sbyangs ba sogs sngon du 'gro bas bkru bar bya/ /nad med bde bas btsa' bar 'gyur/ / mar la sngags pas lus dang bha ga la byugs na mgo 'jug zlos pa la phan zer/ bo dhi rtsi 'bras ba ser skya'i mar dang 'o ma bsres/ / bum rdzas chu dang la sogs pa bum par blugs/ bzlas nas zla mtshan chad nas zhag gsum gyi bar du bkru ba dang*/ bud med la sbyin te/ / mthung du bcug nas khrus byas na mo gsham gyi gzugs sam rang bzhin 'chang ba te 'dzin pa 'ang*/ /nges par bu dang bcas par 'gyur/ / ma btsas par ma dang btsas nas bu la gong gi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gdags byas la/ / maṇ+ḍal du rje btsun ma dang 'byung po spyi dang bgegs dang lha la mchod pa dang bzlas pa mong dang*/ / ma dang bu la khrus ni nyin re nyin re la lan re bya/ /byis pa 'tsho ba'i thabs dam pa te bzang po yin/ / no/ / yang dbang gi las

gsungs pa/ dmigs pa rang gi lte bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad la lter taṃ/ 'dab ma la hrīḥbargyad bung ba'i gzugs/ /spro zhing sgrub bya de yi lte snying gi bcud gzhib par bya/ / sngags ni/ dzaḥho hūṃ a baṃ hi/ a kar+ṣa ya aṅku sha dzaḥ dang por 'bum bzlas la/ slar rdzas/ rang byung dang gi haṃ bsres pa la brgya bzlas te/ dpral bar thig le byas na ni/ / de mthong tsam gyis bud med thams cad dbang du byed/ / do/ /bcu dgu pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba ni/ yang zhus pa med par bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba gsungs pa/ nam mkha 'a lta bu 'i stong pa'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i

tshad dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga ji lta bar/ sgrubs pa dang mchod pa dang dbang bskur ba'i bsam/ /cho ga shes pa 'i slob dpon gyi sa der slob ma la dbang bskur/ / bar bya'o/ /chu dbang gi skur ba'i tshig bcad sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung*/ / ba ste/ de'i ngo bo gang la dbang bskur na/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /gnas thob byed kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ / zhes so/ /bdag po slob dpon gyi dbang chung ba ni skyes pa slob ma de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'chang gi ye shes// te skur sgoms la/ dngos sam yid kyi bud med rig pa'i lha mor mos pa bya/ / shes rab ma bu mo bcu drug lo lon 'khyud/ / pa kho na'i bde ba stong par sbyar te bsgom pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang chung ngu'i dngos gzhi'o/ / no/ / slob dpon gyi dbang gi mtha' sten gsang bar gdams pa ni/ tshig bcad 'di slob dpon chen po'i dbang gi rjes su brjod cing*/ gsang dbang sogs kyi yang sngon du brjod do/ /don ni 'di yin te/ gsang ba slob dpon gyi dbang la sogs pa 'di su la'ang brjod mi bgyi/ / te/ snod min la gal te smras na de yi tshe/ / shin tu rno ba'i shū la mdung rtse gsum ni/ / zhing gi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yi phyag na gnas/ / pa 'dis/ gang gi dam tshig pa ste gsang ba sgrags pas dam tshig nyams par 'jig byed pa/ /de la mdung 'di yis mchog tu 'bigs/ / so ces pa'o/ /gsang dbang gi rab bha ga nas byang sems 'jib par bcas pa dang*/ ma yin na dkar gsum mngar gsum tsha ba gsum dang bsres pa'i tsā ru bza'/ / ba ste/ byang chub kyi sems rdzas dang dkyil 'khor bha ga yin pas/ gsang zhing sba ba'i dbang de gnyis pa'o/ / ༈ de yang spyir gsang bar ma zad/ bum dbang gi snod rung tsam 'ga' zhig la yang gsang dgos pas so/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/

ston pa bla ma sa bu slob ma la phyag rgya gtad par byas nas/ /snyoms par 'jug pa 'i bde ba sa stong nyid dang ro mnyam bsgom/ / pas/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i sa bcu gsum mam/ sa bcu'i bde ba thob pa na/ /shes rab ma dang sbyor ba'i ye shes yin pas de skad zhes brjod do/ / dbang bzhi pa mdor bstan pa ni chags pa mchog dga' dang chags bral las dga' bral las 'das pa/ /dbu mar dga' ba dang por yang mi dmigs pa las de dag gi 'ol spyi tsam mtshon par bya rgyu'i 'od gsal ba/ / sems kyi khong bde ba mi rtog pa rang bzhin bde stong de la rnam pa mi 'dra ba mi 'byung bas mi 'gyur mi 'jigs pas rtag pa mchog tu phra/ /bzhi pa'i ye shes de ni skad cig snga phyi dang yul la 'gro 'ong med/ / slob dpon chen po'i dbang gi ming tsam bstan pa gnyis sbyor las kyang 'gyur med sgrub pas tshangs spyod kyi brtul zhugs chen po pa/ / 'dzag med kyi bde ba che na po grub pa ni slob dpon te/ / chen po'i dbang thob pa/ sems thig le 'pho ba la chags pa ldan yang g.yo sgyus bud med la smod/ / pas tshangs spyod du brdzu ba lhung bzed 'gengs pa'i phyir dge slong ltar ston pa byed pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi 'os min/ / nyi shu pa slob dpon gyi bya ba nyer mkho bstan pa ni/ gtsug lag khang dang dbang dang rab gnas kun la mkho ba'i sa chog dang sta gon dkyil 'khor bri sgrub sogs slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ / bdag 'jug dang slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang dam tshig gi rnam gzhag dang nyes ltung bshags sbyangs dang sbyong du 'jug pa dang*/ las dang dngos grub so so'i dam tshig la byang ba'o/ /lung 'bogs pa dang dam tshig gi cho ga yin te jo bo'i 'grel pas so/ / sbyin sreg las bzhi'i brgyad dam bcu gnyis kyi dbye ba/ sku gzugs mchod rten glegs bam phyag mtshan khang pa skyed tshal/ ljon shing*/ rdzing bu mtshe'u sogs kyis

dang*/ /rab gnas dang mchod yon cho ga gnyis te rten gshegs pa dang lha khang sogs kyi sngon 'gro'o/ / dang*/ /rdo rje dang dril bu dang bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /dgang blugs dang de bzhin rin po che'am rus pa'i rgyan phyag rgya drug / te de lnga dag gi tshad dbyibs mtshan nyid byin rlabs 'chang thabs sogs la mkhas pa sku gzugs kyi tshad dang gshin po la phan gdags pa tha ma'i chog / bgegs dang ngan byed phyir bzlog pa dang*/ 'dod chags pa dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ rdzas dang sngags kyis bsrung ba 'i rigs sna tshogs dang*/ bzlas pa so so byed tshul thabs sna tshogs dang*/ / bad kan sogs rang bzhin gyi nad dang gdon dang rims gsum po sman dang sngags 'khrul 'khor gyis bsrung zhing zhi bas 'joms pa dang*/ / rang bzhin gyi tshe dang longs spyod spel ba'i man ngag dang*/ slob ma dang bstan pa la dad pa'i rgyal po dang khyim bdag sogs kyi rigs 'phel gyi cho ga ste srid spel dang*/ / rgyal po sogs dbang du byed pa dang shin tu gdul dka' ba bsad pa dang gnas nas skrod/ / nang dbye ba dang dbang po drug mnan pa te dbang dang drag shul spyod pa 'di rnams mi dang mi min la sbyor tshul dang*/ lha khang bzhengs thabs gi /cho ga te nyer dgu pa 'di rnams sngags la gzhol ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi las/ / nyer mkho ci rigs pa'o/ /nyer gcig pa rgyud gzhan la kha 'phangs pa ni/ las tshogs rgyud gzhan la kha 'phangs pa ni/ de bzhin du rdo rje slob dpon gyi las ni/ grub pa'i dngul chu sogs/ bcud len dang rig 'dzin rdzas dang lus dang longs spyod kyi rig 'dzin gsum dang*/ /sna tshogs pa'i las te las tshogs ma nges pa rnams dang dngos grub sgrubs tshul dang*/ / dus 'khor dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs nas bshad pa ltar sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la ma bstan pa'i sman gyi sbyor ba rnam mang po/ / de dag rnams ni rgyud dang rgyud sna tshogs pa rnams du mngon par brjod*/

/ cing gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'grel pa gnyis kyis ni sa chog nas sman gyi sbyor ba thams cad sgrol ma nyid kho na'i dbang du byas/ rgyud sna tshogs las gsungs/ 'dir sbyor ba'i don du 'chad do/ /der ma zad ma rgyud gang 'chad kyang gal che ba'i rgyud ni 'di dag ste/ sam bu ṭa dang*/ kha sbyor rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /gdan bzhi de bzhin rdo rje gur/ / sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud dang zla gsang thig le dang*/ /mi g.yo bla med dang*/ gshin bod kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ snga ma rnams gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud 'bum pa zhes gsung ba dus 'khor 'grel par rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa gsung pa nyid yin pa pha rgyud du bshad/ bi rū pa'i 'khrul 'khor na 'bum phrag gsum pa las phyung ba zhes bshad pa gshed dmar kho nar mngon pas ma rgyud do/ /de bzhin du nag 'jigs skor gsum dang*/ bod du 'gyur ba ltar na/ rje gshed dmar po/ / le'u bcu dgu pa ni pha rgyud yin la/ 'dir ni nyer gnyis yin par mngon/ sna tshogs sgrol ma'i rgyud chen dang*/ / ni sna tshogs sgrol ma'i rtogs pa zhes bya ba sho lo ka gsum stong tsam las tshogs gtso bor ston pa bla med yin pa gcig yod gsungs/ ku ru kul+le 'i rtog pa dang*/ ral gcig ma 'i / / rtog pa che chung gnyis dang*/ bcu gcig po de dag ni rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /kun la phan cing gang na las tshogs med pa la/ ji ltar mthun mthun du ci rigs par/ de dag nas kha 'gengs dgos pas ma rgyud gzhan kun gyi sbyor ba las tshogs rgyas pa ra ston byed 'o/ /gzhan rnams so so'i thun mongs ma yin pa gang rnams de dag ni/ / sna tshogs pa'i rgyud dang rgyud de dang de nyid du shes/ / par bya'o/ /rtsa rgyud rgyas pa kun la kha 'gengs mi dgos kyang*/ bsdus rgyud kyi rigs rtsod ldan dus su gang bstan pa/ /de dag thams cad bsdus pa yin pas dgos/ nyer gnyis pa dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes rgyas bshad la bcu gnyis las/

dang po rgyud gzhan mang por sbas pa ni pa'o/ /'on kyang gzhan rnams su te mdo sde dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad dang*/ bla med kha cig tu yang*/ de rnams su sbas pa/ / rgyud 'di ni gang dag sngon gsungs te rgyud rgyas pa rnams su'am pa'i/ / gnyis pa ngo bo mdo tsam brjod pa ni mi shes byis pa rnams te dmyal ba dang dud 'gro tshun chad la yang*/ / sems la rtag tu gnas pa'i rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde chen po/ / don dam pa'i dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes 'khor 'das skabs thams cad du 'gyur ba med/ / pa/ rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pas rang byung rang bzhin chos kyi sku gsal bar rtogs pa zhes brjod/ / gsum pa'i ye shes dang bzhi pa'i khyad par ni/ las dang ye shes phyag dang sbyor ba'i rkyen las byung ba dang skye 'jig byed cing mi rtag phyir/ /shes rab phya'i phyag rgya las byung ba'i ye shes de dbang bzhi pa 'i ye shes min/ / bzhi pa kun rdzob don dam dbye ba ni/ las dang ye shes phyag rgya ni/ /dam pa'i don du ye shes kyi rgyu don dam pa ma yin/ / te las rgya rdul du snang ba'i khams dang ye rgya rnam rtog goms pa'i snang ba tsam yin pas so/ / don dam pa ni brtags pa ste rtog pa dang sgras mtshon pa'i don kun dang bral/ / ba yin pa/ de phy-ir don dam gyi phyag rgya ni 'di kho na'o zhes blos brtags te ngag tu smra bar nus pa ma yin/ / no/ /lnga pa bde ba la 'khrul pa bkag pa ni 'jig rten phal pa rnams 'dod pas 'dod yon la dga' ba rab g.yengs pa'i sems lhan skyes kyi bde ba dam par mi 'jog pa/ de bzhin du bsam gtan pa dang*/ nyan rang dang*/ phar phyin pa/ rnams kyi 'dod pa la dang*/ /chags bral rnams kyi dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' bde thams cad dang*/ / ltar snang gi zhal phyag rnam pa la sems zin pa las skyes pa 'i yid bde dang*/ /thig le 'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor la goms pas rlung cung zad log dhu ti'i phyi rol tu shar ba'i

bde sgrub dang*/ /lte ba'i re kha gtum mo rtog pas bsgom pa 'bad pa bcas/ / pa dang*/ stong nyid la gsal snang mthong bas drangs pa'i yid rab tu dga' ba dang*/ /rlung rnams rkyen gyis re shig dbu mar thim pa'i sems rnam rtog med pa'i bde/ / ba dang*/ mngon shes sogs kyi stobs las/ 'gro don mang po byed nus par 'gyur ba brten nas rab dga' ba dang bde ba dang*/ /bud med las rgya dang sbyor ba'i zhu ba'i reg bde dang*/ /yid ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang mdun na gnas pa ltar rtsa rlung gi byed pas nyams la shar ba phyag rgya'i gzugs brnyan sogs kyi rkyen las bde ba ste/ / bde ba 'di dag 'phral gyi skyon dang bcas pa yin/ / pas dngos po'i gnas lugs ma yin la/ rang bzhin don dam pa'i bde chen ni rgyu rkyen gyis skyed pa glo bur ba las gzhan pa gnas lugs nyid/ / do/ /drug pa don dam dbyings kyi gol sa bcad pa ni/ tha mal kun rdzob kyi lus dang ngag yid gsum dang de las byung ba thams cad dpe dang bcas/ / pa te dpe mtshon thub la/ chags pa ste mchod par dmar lam pa dang chags pa bar ma dang / / ste snang ba dkar lam pa/ chags bral bcas pa'ang ste thob pa nag lam shar ba'i myong bya yi ger te tshig tu brjod pa'i yul bcas/ / lam dus kyi dga' ba bzhi'am/ dbang dang skyed rdzogs kyi dga' bzhi yin yang rung ste/ dga' ba dang ni mchog tu dga'/ / ba dang*/ bral dga' rnams ni rtog pa'i g.yo bar bcas la mi brtan pa/ / la 'jig pa/ yin te dga' bzhi snga ma gsum 'phral 'phral 'gag la phyi ma'ang gsal mi gsal 'gyur ba dang skad cig gis 'jig go / bde ba'i tshor ba dang sdug bsngal dang shugs bstan btang snyoms kyang rig pa po/ / dang bcas pa de rig bya rig byed gzhan rig gi rnam pa can yin la/ rang rig la yang gsal dang mi gsal gyi don kun rdzob brda tsam ming tsam blos gzhag pa tsam ste/ /de dag thams cad rang rang gi ngo bo de dang*/

de la snying po te rang gi ngo bos grub pa med/ /chags pa lam gyi mchog dga' la ni chags pa de nyid kyi rang gi dngos po ngo bo med/ / la/ chags bral lam gyi dga' bral la yang chags bral rang gi dngos pos grub pa med/ / la/ dbu ma lam gyi dga' ba las kyang dbu ma rang gi ngo bo med/ / de/ de rnams thams cad rten 'brel rkyen las byung ba tsam/ / yin pas so/ / bdun pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ dngos po dang dngos po kun gyi mtshan nyid dang bral ba/ / 'di ni dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid ste chos nyid kyi dngos/ / po ste ngo bor yod pa/ ye shes 'di yi rang bzhin rten brten pa bcu gnyis dag pa'i mi 'gyur bde/ / bar gnas pa sgoms pas mngon du gyur pa'o/ /'di ni dpe sa mtshon du med pa dang yi ge sa brjod du med pa dang*/ / rnam rtog gi g.yo ba sa gos pa med pa dang rang bzhin 'pho 'gyur 'jig ba med/ / pa 'di ni/ don dam pa'i rang rig rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis/ / skul kun 'byung las rang grol bas/ mya ngan 'das pa 'i sems nyid 'di gcig pu don dam pa bden/ / pa'o/ /brgyad pa de nyid dam pa'i bdag tu bstan pa ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad sems kyis bkod pas kun gyi byed pa po yin la 'di la ni byed po med/ / ste rang nyid spros bral yin pas so/ /'jig rten pa'i shes pa can rnams kyang 'di dang phyogs mtshungs tsam shes nas 'di la bdag dang sems can nam srog bcas dang*/ / rdul mun snying stobs cha mnyam du 'dres pa'i gtso bo dang dbang phyug sogs dang gzhan sde bye brag pa dang 'das pa'i ye shes nyi tshes/ rang sde'i nyan thos sde gnyis rdul phran sogs/ / thams cad 'gyur med/ ye shes 'di kho na la rtog tshul log pas rnam par brtags/ / dgu pa nges don gyi 'gog lam gnyis su bstan pa ni/ 'di gzhig tu med pa'i sems nyid yin pa dang sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul gzhi/

rdo rje sems dpa' don dam pa'i 'dod yon mtshan dper bcas pa'i lhag pa'i lha/ / rdul gyis ye nas ma gos pas 'gog pa chen po dang kun 'byung gi chos nyid kyang yin la/ kun 'byung gis ma gos pa'i lam bden chen po pa/ / 'di sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid sgrib gnyis kyis ye nas ma gos pas kun rdzob bden pa'i rang bzhin te/ dri ma kun rdzob mtha' dag sngon nas zad pa kho na dang*/ / 'di nyid las nyon gyi yang chos nyid de/ chos kun gyi rang bzhin gdod nas ye shes gnas pa sangs rgyas pa/ / 'di ni bden gnyis rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i tshul 'di sangs rgyas kun gyis bstan/

/ pa'o/ /bcu pa rang bzhin kun gzhir bshad pa ni ji ltar mtshan mo me mar khang par dkar khung lnga par bus/ / pa te spar na/ skar khung lnga las phyogs lnga las 'od phyir snang ba 'i / / tshe me mar gyi 'od dum bu tha dad lngar snang ngo*/ / de bzhin du kun rdzob snang ba sna tshogs 'char rung gi sems gsal rig tsam gyi kun gzhi'i me mar 'dod/ / gzugs sogs rnam rig tha dad shar ba'i tshe dbang shes lnga zhes rnam par sprul/ / pa ste kun gzhi la gzugs su snang ba'i rnam rig gi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshe mig shes ces 'dogs pa la sogs pa'o/ /rnam pa la 'khrul nas bdag gis mig shes kyis gzugs mthong ngo zhes sogs/ dbang shes kyi me mar lnga zhes yid kyis rnam shes kyis rtog / te de yang rnam rig rnam pa lnga po dang*/ de dang 'brel ba rnams yul byas ming don du snang ba'i rnam rig 'dzin no/ /yang sems myong bya kun rdzob gsal rig gi rgyun la bdag tu 'khrul nas/ 'od tshogs drug dang me kun gzhi rdzas gzhan yin no zhes/ /yid gzhan te nyon yid de 'khrul ba'i phyir/ blun po la brten na sa de'i 'khor sems 'byung ba ni ngar 'dzin par byed/ / do/ /de ltar na kun gzhi chu las rnam shes bdun chu rlabs 'byung ba ji bzhin du ltos/ / shig bcu gcig pa yon tan dbyer med pa'i don ni/ de lta bu'i kun gzhi gsal rig de'i khong nas mi rtog pa ngo bor rang rig rang gsal kun rdzob mi 'char ba de ni chos dbyings te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku ye shes/ mdzad pa'i nus pa/ zhing du 'char ba nus pa sogs chos gang dang gang de/ / thams cad sems can re re'i sems kyi khams la re rer gnas/ / mod/ sku dang ye shes yon tan sogs so sor dbye ba med cing sa 'og gter ltar sa bcu pa man gyis ye shes ma rtogs mthong med pa/ / dbyings kyi ye shes gser khams lta bu/ kun gzhi rnam shes rdo lta bu la gnas pa bzhin/
