/ no/ /bcu gnyis pa lhun grub rdo rje bzhi bshad pa ni/ lus la chos nyid sku dang ngag la gsung sems la chos nyid thugs dang*/ 'khrig pa sogs bde ba 'khrul sems la ye shes rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi ye nas gnas pa mngon du gyur pa/ / na/ don dam pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi sku sprul sku dang*/ brag cha ste grags stong don dam pa longs sku dang*/ nam mkha'i dngos/ / te spros pa gzung 'dzin dang bral ba chos sku dang*/ bde gshegs snying po yon tan can/ / rang bzhin don dam pa'i bde ba dri mas dag pa'i tshe/ bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya/ / 'o/ /de dag gi rten 'brel 'gros la lte ba sprul sku dang sad dus mgrin pa longs sku dang rmi lam snying kha'i pad+ma/ / chos sku dang sems med/ gzhan yang ni mgo bo ste spyi bo bde chen gyi sku dang 'khrig sems su ra rab brjod pa/ / yin pa'i bag chags bzhin las sems can rnams kyi skye 'chi bar do'i srid pa gsum 'grel ba gnyis kyis sa 'og sa stengs sa bla ste srid pa gsum gyi sems can du bshad do/ /dkyus ltar na spyi bor gsum ka'i thun mongs su btang ngo*/ /rtsa 'khor lo bzhi las 'byung ba dang*/ / rtsa 'khor lo bzhi dag pa na srid gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ 'di nyid du ni thim pa 'i rnam gzhag byas pa 'o/ / dbang bskur ba ni dri ma 'khrud pa'i don te spangs pa mi ldog pas rdo rje ye shes kyis <te gtso mos > shes bya kun mkhyen pas de skad ces gsungs so/ / shes rab kyi dum bu la/ zhus pa dang*/ lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas zhu ba po rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa de bzhin gshegs ma dang*/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i 'phags ma yang yin tshul yang 'phags mar ston pa rnams dang*/ tshangs ma la sogs pa rtsa ba'i 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma mo rnams dang*/ de dag gi bran mo'i rgyal mo zla gsang thig le las gsungs pa lta bu'i dbang phyug ma

nyer brgyad rnams dang*/ sngags kyi skal ldan yin yang 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i dbang ltar byas nas/ lha 'i bud med dang*/ mi dang*/ klu dang*/ dri za dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi bud med dang*/ srin po dang*/ mi'am ci mo la sogs pa'i bud med tshad med kyang tshad la dga' ba 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa ri rab grangs med pa/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rdul snyed rnams zhu ba'i rgyu the tshom du gyur yid gnyis su gyur nas/ zhu ba'i yul bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la ji ltar zhu ba'i tshul 'di skad ces gsol to/ / rtsa rgyud las/ (1) 'das pa'i dus na rdo rje can/ sangs rgyas dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor sprul/ zhes gsungs pa'i/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung dang*/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje 'chang yis/ /dbugs dbyung ba 'i dkyil 'khor ni tshul ji ltar gdul bya la bstan/ (2) / de'i snying po rtsod dus 'dir sogs la rtsod/ dus 'dir rgyud nyung ngu kho na gsung ba 'i rgyu mtshan ci/ (3) / nges par 'dod chags chags chen 'di/ /zhes pa la/ sangs rgyas thob pa la/ chags chen gyi lam nges par gsungs pa 'i rgyu mtshan gang*/ (4) / de nas sngags rnams gsungs pa la/ rig sngags bzlas pa byed 'dod pa rnams kyis/ / tshul ji ltar lha la bsnyen par bgyid/ / dgos ces le'u dang po la bzhi tsam dris pa'o/ (5) /bum pa can gyi sbyor bas dag par byas nas/ zhes pa la rlung gi sbyor bas lus dag pa ra / / byed pa'i rgyu mtshan dang byed thabs gang lags /(6) dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas zhes gsungs pa la/ de bzhin du dga' ba la sogs pa bzhi'i ngos 'dzin/ (7) bud med sgyu ma'i sogs la ci/ /mchog gyur pa'i bud med dam tshig yod ces bya ba ci zhes/ (8) ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyi sogs la/ mi gtsang ba sogs dang*/ /ngan par zos smig mkhan phyags dar ba sogs ngan par spyod pa thams cad kyis/

/ mi 'chang bar grol bar 'byung ba'i thabs kyi bdag nyid gang yin pa/ /lha lags zhes bos nas mgon po khyod kyi sa bshad du gsol/ / zhes le'u dang po dang gnyis pa la yang dri ba gsum bzhi'o/ (9) /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad bya ste zhes/ lam 'di la rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dgos na sngar bsdus pa/ phyogs gcig tsam las ma gsungs pas de yang ci/ (10) / btsan thabs sbyor bas dbugs bkag na zhes gsungs pa'i btsan thabs sbyor ba'ang sgom tshul ji ltar 'gyur/ / (11) skyes pa bud med dngos grub 'gyur/ zhes gsungs na/ nye rgyu skabs/ bud med dang ni skyes pa dag / sngags phyag rgya dang bcas na dogs pa chung yang*/ mngon par 'grub pa 'i tshul la 'ang bshad du gsol/ / de ltar zhus pa la dri ba bcu gcig go /gnyis pa la yang bcu gcig gi dang po dbugs dbyung gnyis bstan pa ni nyon cig gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin ma nor ba rdo rje ma rnams nyon/ / cig mdor bstan ni sngon byung dang sgom bya gnyis ka la/ dbugs dbyung rnam pa gnyis su bstan to/ / sems can gdul bya rnams spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang sgrib gnyis las dang*/ bye brag so so'i skabs kyi nyes skyon gyis mnar ba'i dbugs mi thon pa lta bu la/ dkyil 'khor sprul/ chos bshad pas grol ba thob pa/ bde bar dbugs phyin pa ni sngon byung ston pa'i mdzad pa rnam 'phrul gyi dbugs dbyung gi don no/ /mtshon byed brda'i dbugs dbyung gnyis dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi dbugs dbyung gnyis las/ dang po ni dkyil 'khor/ sprul/ bshad/ mdzad pa nyid yin te/ 'di la dang por rdo rje sems/ / dpa'i dbugs dbyung dang*/ phyi nas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dbugs dbyung 'byung ba 'o/ / rgyas bshad la rdo rje 'chang ngam/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbugs dbyung ni/ dus ni 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ / brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i ches snga rol gyi bskal pa la/

'dul byed lha ni dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ / nyid kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid thams cad rnams dkyil 'khor la bsdus nas/ /rig ma ye shes btsun mo de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par rol/ / zhing khams ni mtshon byed chos 'byung gi rnam pa rang bzhin spros bral nam mkha'i khams la gnas pa/ / gzhug mkhan ye shes rgya mtsho sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rnam rol ba/ / rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor sprul/ mdzad pa des sa bcu pa rnams/ sangs rgyas pa la 'jog go /so so skye bo'i sa pa rnams byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa la bzhag pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems sar pa mong ni ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par bskyed/ / do/ /de yan longs sku'i mdzad pa'i tha snyad dbye/ chos bstan pa lam ni/ bdag nyid bde ba che na po'i rang bzhin/ / gdul bya ni sems can khams la spros zhing rjes zhugs pas/ / par mdzad de bde ba chen po'i lam bstan/ de dus kyi gdul bya thams cad bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin byang chub ste sangs rgyas thob/ / dgos pa ni bde bas mngon par zhen pa'i gdul bya rnams la/ / sngar bde ba'i ye shes skyes/ skyes pa'i steng du/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis stong nyid kho na gtso bor bstan/ / pas/ gdul bya de rnams chos bstan pa des grangs med pa'i 'gro ba mngon par byang chub/ / pa thob pa'o/ / de bzhin du gdul bya/ 'dul byed/ zhing khams/ dus/ lam/ dgos pa ste/ phyi ma rnams la drug drug gis don tshan du rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung la/ rigs lnga las/ dang po rnam snang gi dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor bstan tshul ni/ phyi nas bde ba'i lam nub nas stong pa kho na ra mngon par zhen pa rnams/ /thams cad chad par lta ba zin nas gdul bya gtso bo rnams dmyal bar lhung tu rung bar gyur pa dang phal pa mang po zhig lhungs pa rang yang yin pa sa/ /rgyal ba rtag pa ste

rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor rnam par sprul te/ / stong pa ma yin mi stong min zhes so/ / dbu ma 'i lam la ni rnam par bzhag / lam dpe de dag rang dang gzhan don cher bsgrub ste bsgoms pas/ / gdul bya dpag yas mchog tu grol ba sangs rgyas pa ra byas/ / pa'o/ /de gnyis la dang po sems can gyi khams la bde bar spro ba mthun pa'i chos bstan/ stong pa dang dbu ma bstan/ rnam pa mi 'dra bar byung ba ni mthun pa'i chos bstan pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbugs dbyung ni stong pa nyid kyis bstan pa'i stobs nub pa na dbu ma tsam gyis kun rdzob kyis 'dzin pa ma sel bar/ stong pa min zhes pa la 'khrul nas/ kun rdzob kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i rtog pas ngar 'dzin pa can/ / zas gos longs spyod sogs kyi rnam rtog du mas rnam par dkrugs pa 'i / / gdul bya/ de dag gzhan gyi bya ba sna tshogs pa'i bsam pa kun/ /rdzogs byed bya ba mchog nam mkha'i mdzod sgrubs te sbyin pa rlabs po che la bskul/ / ba'i phyir/ rin chen 'byung ldan rdo rje/ nyi ma 'i dkyil 'khor rnam sprul pas/ / so so'i longs spyod 'bad med 'bad med kyi bsam pa grub pas sems tshim ste/ gdul byar de dag bla med byang chub la/ / mchog tu dga' zhing spro bas gzhol bar 'gyur/ / te rim gyis thams cad grol ba'o/ / gsum pa pad+ma gar dbang gis dbugs dbyung ni/ nam mkha'i mdzod ma thob pa de dag gzhan don la brtson pa'i ming la brten nas bu smad la sogs pa'i gzhan rkyen las rjes su chags ldan pa/ / de rnams de tshe 'dod chags kyis bcings pas/ / byang chub ma thob cing yi dwags su skye bar 'gyur ba la pad+ma gar dbang 'od dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par sprul te/ / 'dod chags nyid kyi rang bzhin bde ba ra ston pa 'i lam gyis ni/ /brjod du med pa'i grangs kyis 'gro ba mngon par byang chub/ / thob bo/ /de gnyis mthun pa'i chos ston pa gtso che'o/

/bzhi pa don yod grub pa'i dbugs dbyung ni/ phyi nas rang bzhin bde chen gyi lam nub/ 'dod chags bde bar byed pa'i tshig la brten nas tha mal gyi bde ba la chags ldan rnams/ / lam sgom pa la le los mngon par nyams te mi sgom par gyur nas/ /blo ngan te rmongs pa'i 'jig rten rnams sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas rnam par 'khrugs/ / pa'i tshe/ gzhan don myur bas myur 'gro'o/ / rta mchog rgyal po 'i dkyil 'khor chen po rab nyid sprul te/ /sems can gdul bya thams cad/ brtson 'grus kyi lam dang gnas la bzhag / cing*/ de yang le los chos ma gtogs des bya ba rnam dag la rmongs nas byi rkun srog gcod slu ba sogs kyis sdug bsngal ba'i sems can la/ brtson 'grus chen pos chos rtogs su bcug spyod pa de dag dang rnam pa mthun pa la ngo bo gzhan don du bsgyur nas 'phrin las sna tshogs kyi don byed pa ni/ byi bo rkun po dgra byed pa ste gsod dang slu ba la sogs/ / dga' ba rnams rang rang dang mthun tshul gyis mngon sprul bas/ / gdul bya thams cad rdo rje'i gnas chos sku la bzhag / go /'di la brtson 'grus mi mthun pa dang*/ 'phrin las mthun pa'i chos bstan pa gnyis po cha mnyam mo/ /lnga pa he ru ka'i dbugs dbyung ni/ gzhi bsgyur ba'i lam byang chub pa na/ rtsod pa dang ldan ci spyod pa ngan pa sna tshogs pa/ / spyod pa'i 'jig rten ma rungs par gyur te thams cad shin tu khro zhing gtum pa gsod pa dang rdeg pa sogs gdug pa 'i las la dga' ba can/ /rab tu khros pa'i rnam pa can he ru ka 'i dkyil 'khor chen po ra sprul pa/ / mdzad de/ / drag shul gyi sbyor ba gsod pa la dgyes pa ltar ston pa ra gyur/ / te/ gdul bya ma rungs pa srin po dang gnod sbyin dang 'byung po dang gnod/ / bco brgyad sogs dang*/ ma mo ste 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ srin po dang*/ spyod yul gcig pa rnams thams cad lus dang longs spyod

bcom par byas 'di ni mi mthun pa dang*/ mthun pa'i chos bstan pa zer te/ spyod pa ni mthun yul mi mthun te gdul bya nyid tshar bcad pas mi 'dod pa thog tu phab nas gtul ba'o/ / rig sngags dang*/ /rdzas dang mtshon cha 'khrul 'khor dang*/ /sman gyis kyang ni gdul dka' zhi bas mi 'dul ba de/ thams cad bcom/ / te nga rgyal dang bral ba rnams la chos bstan to/ /da lta sngags kyi bstan pa drag shul sbyor ba mngon brjod 'ong ba rgyu mtshan yin la/ dkyil 'khor lha he ru ka'i bstan pa yin gsung ngo*/ /mthar mngon spyod nub/ tha mal gyi zhe sdang chos su ston pa'i skabs zhe sdang gdug gnon zhi ba'i phyir/ /slar yang bde chen mgon po rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung

la/ / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ste/ / de dag ni dbugs dbyung dkyil 'khor dam pa 'i rnam bzhag go /'di dag gi dkyil 'khor rgyud 'di na ming tsam ma gtogs mi gsal yang bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba thig le las 'byung ngo*/ /mdor bsdus dbugs dbyung gnyis su bstan pa ni/ 'o/ /'dir ni mtshon bya don gyi dbugs dbyung ni rgyud gsum la so sor sbyar te rgyu'i skabs la sbyar na don dam bden pa rdo rje 'chang dang*/ kun rdzob bden pa rigs lnga'i dbugs dbyung ste/ / 'bras bu la sbyar na longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje 'chang dang sprul pa 'i sku rigs lnga'i dbugs dbyung zhes/ /gzhan ni rgyu gzhi lam gyi sems rdo rje 'chang gi dang 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa thob nas gzhan don byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ste/ / mtshon bya don gyi dbugs dbyung gnyis su bstan pa'o/ /'dir yang don dam rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung rnam pa gnyis/ / yin te/ / bde ba che na po lhan cig skyes pa dang de kho na nyid stong pa nyid do/ /kun rdzob sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung yang*/ gnyis kyang 'jig rten snang ba sgyu ma lta bu la der rtog pas/ skyed rim dang rlung sems tsam gyi dang*/ / dkyil 'khor zhes ni re zhig gnyis su bzhag / go / mtshon bya don gyi dbugs dbyung la sgom bya dbugs dbyung zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsdus rgyud gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/ tshe thung bas long med pa dang*/ bsod nams zhan pa sa slab mi nus pa dang*/ / de'i rgyu srog chags gsod la dga' ba dang*/ / 'dod yon sna tshogs sgrub pa sogs 'dod pa la spyod pas g.yengs par gyur pa/ /da lta rtsod dus rgyud rgyas pa mi mkho nas/ rgyud rnams nyung ngur gsungs/ / so/ /gsum pa chags lam gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang lam gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus 'bar bas grangs med gsum nyung ngu'i mtha' gzhan ci rigs su sbyar/

byang sems theg pa bde ba pas/ ring du 'gor ba grangs med sum brgya sogs dang*/ ji ltar myur yang*/ / bskal pa grangs med sum cu rtsa gnyis/ /'bad par byed kyang da dung lam de nyid kyi rang 'bras sa bcu pa las mi 'da' bas bla na med pa'i byang chub med/ / la/ lam dka' ba med pa'i bde bas tshe 'dir bla med byang chub 'grub 'gyur pa/ /de 'i phyir 'dod chags chen pa ོ'i lam nges pa ra bstan/ / pa yin no/ /phar phyin theg pa kho na'i rang 'bras sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci byas pa la/ rgyud bde bas sgrubs na 'bras bu bde ba dam pa'i sku thob par 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas kyi bde ba ni lhan skyes kyi bde chen po / / yin pas/ 'bras bu dang mtshungs pa'i lam las rgyu sgrub pa/ / sngags kyi theg pa yin pas 'dis bla med byang chub 'grub kyi phar phyin la de med pas so/ /thabs ma tshang na stong pas mya ngan las 'da'/ / ba'i mthar lhung ngo*/ /de yang dngos su na byang chub sems dpa'am 'phags pa lam nor ba mi srid cing sa bcu'i tha mar sngags la mi 'jug pa mi srid mod/ gal te srid na bde ba med na sems mar me shi ba ltar 'gro/ lha sku sogs med na sku mi 'grub gzhan don mi 'byung ngo*/ /bzhi pa bsnyen pa spyi'i cho ga ni gnyis te/ dang po'i bsnyen pa dang*/ bsnyen pa chen po'o/ /dang po la lnga las/ dang po sgrub por 'gyur ba'i gang zag ni/ tshe 'dir mtshams med sogs sdig pa drag po byas pa med pa dang chos la dad pa che ba dang*/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas byang sdom ma nyams pa dang*/ /ser sna shas chung ba dang nor dang rigs dang dbang thang sogs kyis dregs pa med pa dang thos pa la sogs pas nga rgyal med/ / pa te/ bdun tshang ba 'dis ni g.yengs rkyen med par gcig tu sgrubs na dngos grub the tshom med par nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ / sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bzang po smin pa dang skye ba gzhan du 'grub pa dang*/

tshe 'dir yang brtson 'grus drag po'i khyad par sa 'ga' la thog mar mtshan nyid bdun po de ma tshangs yang 'grub pa yod la/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas de dag tshang ba shugs la nges par dgos/ mtshams med lnga dag las ci rigs pa sngags kyi dam tshig ma blangs gong du byas pa yang*/ / phyis nges 'byung gi sems snying nas skyes nas/ sangs rgyas 'dod pas 'dir zhugs te de phyin dam tshig dag par byas nas/ 'di yis sgrub pa por 'gyur na/ /gzhan sngags la ma zhugs kyi dang por sdig pa cung zad byas pa dang*/ rigs ngan dang*/ nyon mongs shas che ba dang*/ zas dang spyod pa ngan pa sogs/ lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ / 'on kyang de dag tshe 'dir 'grub mi 'grub ci rigs su yod cing*/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs na sdig pa byed pa dang*/ sems bskyed nyams pas dam tshig nyams pa'i phyir gtan nas mi 'grub po/ gnyis pa sngon 'gro ni/ bgegs 'joms pa'i phyir bdud rtsi 'khyil ba 'i bsnyen pa'i cho ga la brten nas sngags ni/ /dang por 'bum phrag gcig nyung mthar bzlas pa byas nas/ / bsod nams spel ba'i phyir mchod rten bzhengs pa la sogs pa sku gzugs dang glegs bam bzhengs pa byed pa dang*/ / bye ma mchod rten dang*/ gzhan yang lha khang dang dge 'dun swā tsa sogs kyang bzung ngo*/ / mchod dang bskor ba la sogs bya/ / gsum pa grogs ni sgrub pa po chags ldan ltar na/ yan lag lus ni mdzes pa mchog gam lus ma nyams pa dang las 'bras sogs chos la dad pa dang ldan pa'i/ /bud med lo bcu drug lon pa sogs/ yid 'ong ngam yang na gzhan/ / sgrubs pa po chags bral gyi brtul zhugs can gyi grogs ni skyes pa sngags la spyod pa ste dbang thob dam tshig ma nyams lam sgom par mos pa'o/ / snying rje dang blo shes rab rig pa dang ldan pa/ / gang la'ang mi 'jigs pa'i snying stobs ldan pa 'i mtshan nyid tshang ba grogs rnam dag zhes bya/ / mtshan nyid 'di rnams sgrubs grogs kyi phyag rgya mo la'ang tshang dgos so/

/bzhi pa gnas ni/ gnas gang na/ bram ze yod na bzlas pa dang sbyin sreg lha mchod kho bo cag gi 'os kyis shākya'i dge sbyong gi min ces gnod pa byed pas/ de med pa dang*/ mu stegs phal cher spyir sangs rgyas pa la sdang zhing*/ khyad par nang pa sngags sgrubs pa mthong na 'dis bsgrub na nged kyi sngags mkhan pham par byed snyams nas gsod du 'ong te/ de gnyis snying rje med cing sdig pa mi shes pas so/ / nyan thos rnams spyir theg chen la sdang*/ bye brag sngags pa la ngan du smra bas/ de dag med/ / pa'o/ / dang po'i las can gyi sngags pa ni de dag med cing*/ dmangs dang tshong pa mang ba'i grong khyer der ram nags sam ri bor gnas par bya/ / 'o/ /lnga pa cho ga ni/ thog mar bsnyen pa chung ngu ni bris sku bkrams pa la mchod pa dang gtor ma'i cho gas 'bul ba dang bcas shing*/ /dang por me tog phog pa'i rigs kyi lha nyid bsgom/ / nas sngags bye ba dang gtso bo'i sngags bye bar bzlas pa la brtson/ / par bya'o/ / phyi nas bsnyen pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs rnam par bsgoms nas/ /bzlas pa 'bru grangs kyi 'bum du bya ba yin/ / no/ /gnyis pa sgrubs pa'i spyod pa ni sbyin sreg mchod pa la thun bzhir drag par mngon par brtson/ / pa dang*/ rdul tshon dang rdul tshon gyi/ / dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ni tshad dang bshad tshod du ldan pa ste cho ga tshangs bas bris nas ni/ / dus zla ba drug tu bdag mdun dbyer med du sgoms nas mchod pa dang bzlas pa rgyun mi 'chad pa ra bya/ / gsum pa sgrubs chen gyi spyod pa ni/ don tshan gsum ste/ de'i dang po khyad par bdun dang ldan pa'i spyod pa ni sngags pa ting 'dzin brtan pa dang*/ nus pa brtan pa/ sngags dang de bzhin grogs/ / mtshan nyid tshang bas bar chad mi byed pa dang*/ phyogs bshad tshod ma nor ba dang*/ dus kyang nam zla tshes nyin mtshan snga phyi sogs ma 'khrul ba dang*/ rdzas 'dzoms shing ma nyams pa

dang brtson 'grus drag po rgyun ma chad pa dang*/ /lha ni mnyes pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba ste/ 'di ni dngos grub 'grub pa'i rgyu'i khyad par bdun par gsungs pa yin/ / gnyis pa sgrubs pa po'i mtshan nyid/ dam tshig kha zas tshun chod phra mo gcig kyang ma nyams pa/ brtson 'grus ma nyams pas skyo ba cung zad kyang mi skye ba/ gang la'ang khong mi khro zhing sdug bsngal dka' ba ji tsam yang bzod pa sgrubs chen la bzhugs skabs dang*/ / sngags dang lha dang cho ga dang chos dang gang zag la dad pa dang snying rje dang sngags gsum skad cig kyang ma nyams/ / pa dang*/ gnyid rmugs sogs kyi rgyu las byung ba'i shes bzhin ma yin pa'i le lo med pa rnams tshang na dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ / ro/ /༈ stobs bzhi tshangs pa'i spyod pa ni skabs 'dir 'byung po phal pas dngos grub ster mi nus pas srin po'i rgyal po dang*/ tshangs sogs lha chen dang*/ gnod sbyin pho mo rdzu 'phrul can dang 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha dngos su grub pa dang rig sngags grub pa'i drod thob mthu ldan ste rigs sngags kyang mig nad zhi ba'i sngags sogs phra mo 'grub rung dngos grub mi 'byung bas rtsa ba'i rig sngags yin pa'o/ / zhing*/ / de dag tshangs yang sngags pa/ sems stobs chung na bar chod 'byung bas chen po dang*/ ldan pa dang 'dod pa'i lha nam mkhar gnas pa mang po mthong ba dang lus cher yang ba dang mi min gyi longs spyod ci bder spyod nus pa sogs/ mtshan ma thob/ / na/ sgrub po 'di yis dngos grub bsgrub na 'grub pas bsgrub par bya yi/ /gzhan du de dag ma tshang bar bsgrub na ni dka' ba don med pas nyon mongs par 'gyur/ / ro/ ༈ /lnga pa rlung gi sbyor ba'i rnam gzhag ni bzhi las/ dang po rlung sbyor ni/ ltar stangs g.yon nas lta bas dgang ba la bslab pa dang*/ /g.yas kyi lta ba sa dgug pa 'i rlung sbyor la bslab de bzhin no/ / dpral ba'i lta ba 'i lta stangs dang*/

re tsa ka / stai rdul mtha' can la bslab sna rtser lta ba'i lta stangs kyis bum pa can la bslab pa yin no/ / gnyis pa rlung gi mtshan nyid ni lte ba 'i 'khor lo las ni rlung bcu po thams cad bskyed pa/ / yin kyang bya ba so so'i gnas su byed do/ / me yi dkyil 'khor dgu brgya pa nyid dang ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor dgu brgya pa nyid dang*/ /de bzhin chu 'i dkyil 'khor dgu brgya pa dang dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor dgu brgya pa te/ /'khor lo sems kyi kun spyod pas/ / sna sgo nas rgyu tshul me rlung*/ steng du rgyu ba dang*/ rlung gi rlung logs ste stengs la sogs dang chu rlung thang ga dang sa rlung 'og tu rgyu zhing gnas/ / pa yin no/ /de dag 'byung khams kyi dbang du byas byas la/ gnas so so'i rlung bcu ni srog chu shas che ba snying kha nas bya ba byed pas nyid dang ni thur sel pas dbang byas pa mos mtshams nas gnas pa'i bya ba byed pa dang*/ /gyen rgyu me shas che bas mgrin par bya ba byed pa dang*/ khyab byed nam mkha' shas che ba tshig pa kun tu bya ba byed pa dang*/ me dang mnyam rgyu gnas/ / sa rlung shas che ba lte bar byed pa rnams dang / 'khor lo bzhi'am lnga'am drug gam bco brgyad thams cad kun tu 'gro shing so so'i bya ba ci rigs par spyod pa/ / 'o/ / klu dang rus sbal sogs rtsangs pa dang*/ lha byin dang*/ gzhu las rgyal ba rnams de bzhin/ / du snye ma la sogs pa/ 'tsher ba dang*/ glo ba dang*/ lha byin/ mkhal ma rnams la rim pas rnam par gnas/ / pa ste nang gi lus bskyed pa'i bya ba byed/ rim pa de kho nas rlung de rnams mig dang rna ba dang ni sna/ /lce dang lus kyi dbang po la gnas nas byang chub sems/ / 'dzin pa dang khyab pa dang dbang shes so so bskyed pa dang*/ khams de dag 'phel 'grib byed do/ /gsum pa rlung gi sgo ni de bzhin du/ spyi gtsug smin mtshams/ lte ba/ chu lam/ bshang sgo/ mig rna ba/

sna/ kha te sku'i sgo ni dgu dang yang*/ / 'khor lo bzhi rtsa mdud kha sbyor ni/ grong bzhi te re re na yang 'byung ba lnga'am/ rlung bcu thams cad kyi cha shas gnas pas so/ /de dag dang ni sgo bzhi pa/ / ni snying kha'i phyogs kyi 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ste gsung gi sgo bzhi'o/ /thugs kyi sgo ni dam pa ste bzang po gnyis nyid ste/ snying kha'i steng 'og gi rtsa mdud/ thugs kyi dang*/ /dman pa ngan pa 'i sgo ni rnam pa gnyis/ / de yang bu ga dgu'i rlung gis lus rags pa skyed 'bri byed pas sku'i sgo dang*/ ngag rlung rnams kyis 'gro 'ong byed pa yin pas gsung gi sgo dang*/ lam dus ma byas na sems gzung 'dzin rnam rtog skyed cing*/ lam dus byas na bde stong gi ye shes 'char sa yin pas thugs kyi sgor bzhag pa'o/ /te dbu ma'i yas sna dang mas sna gnyis su gzhed la/ 'grel ba gnyis las smin mtshams dang spyi gtsug gi sgo gnyis te/ gtum mo'i 'bar mtha'i sgo la bshad do/ /bzhi pa dgos pa ni/ byed pa bcings ba'i sbyor bas rtsa mdud kyi sgo phye zhing*/ /yur ba legs par bcos pa las ni chu bde bar 'bab ltar/ /de bzhin rlung gi sbyor ba sna tshogs pas rtsa lam sbyangs pa yis/ / gnas skabs su nad bya/ mngon shes than thun gyi yon tan skye lus yangs shing bde/ thig le rtsi 'dod 'gro 'ong thub pa dang*/ mthar thug dbu mar rlung dang rnam rtog 'gags/ ye shes kyi sku 'grub pas lus ni dag par byed pa yin/ / no/ /drug pa dga' ba la sogs pa'i ye shes bshad pa la/ dang po sgrub pa po bshad pa ni/ sgrub po'i dbang po gang zhig ste/ dbu mar thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa rlung gi nus pa thob pa ste/ dbang po zhes pa'i sgras sgrub po phal pa ma yin par bstan/ ༈ gtso bo so thar gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa gcig dgos pas/ tha ma yang*/ dge bsnyen nam 'bring dge tshul lam rab dge slong yang rung ste

<de yang gtso bor te/ mtha' gcig tu so thar rigs bdun blangs pa dgos pa ma yin no/ /tshangs spyod la mi rung sems pa'i log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir dge tshul sogs smos so/> /zhes pas las rgya bsten pa dang*/ tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa mi 'gal te/ rlung gis thig le 'ching nus cing*/ ltar snang dang*/ stong nyid sgom pa yod na/ rten dge slong mchog de las rgya brten pas dge slong gi sdom pa gong 'phel du 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa gnas bstan pa ni/ mu stegs nyan thos skal med kyi skye bo rnams la shin tu gsang dgos pas/ shin tu dben pa'i ri bo'am rang 'khrungs kyi nags tshal lam/ rang gi bdag tu bzung ba'i skyed mos tshal lam sgom khang ngam grong yin yang rung ste/ rang gi

khyim du gnas pas/ gsum pa phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ lus gzhon sha chags pas lang tsho ldan ma lo bcu drug ma yan chad skye gnas ma nyams pa'i gzhon nu ma'am/ nyi shu ma nyer lnga ma la sogs pa ji srid du lang tsho ma nyams pa'i dar bab ma blangs te/ bcu gnyis ma lon pa dang lnga bcu thal ba spyod pa'i skabs ma gtogs brten du mi rung ngo*/ / gzugs mdzes shing bzang mig yangs shing dkar nag phyed pa mdzes skra bzang ba/ / nag ser li ba'am ring ba'i don/ spyir sngags dang khyad par chags chen gyi spyod pa'i lam 'dir blo mos pa brtan po rnyed nas ni/ /mchog tu dga' ba 'i spyod pa dga' bzhi rab tu brtsams/ / rig ma de tshe 'di'i zas nor gtam dbang thang sogs 'dod pa'i longs spyod la ma chags par nges 'byung che shing*/ / dga' bzhi'i nyams len gyi bde ba la mngon par rjes su chags pa/ / skye sa gzhan la rang bzhin gyis mi dga' zhing*/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa mthong ba tsam gyis dga' ba/ / skye ba/ skye ba/ khyad par rtsa bzang ba dang*/ bde ba che ba dang*/ rnam rtog chung ba dag gsum 'dzom na/ spyar 'debs pa'i dpes sgrubs pa po'i rtsa dag pa dang*/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa skyed pa dang gsum 'byung ngo*/ / de ltar du brten pa las sbyor ba'i dngos grub ste mchog gi dngos grub thob/ / bzhi pa dga' bzhi dngos la/ dga' ba bshad pa ni/ thabs shes gnyis ka lus ni sha chang dang bcud kyi sbyor ba sogs kyi rab tu brtas shing stobs dang ldan pa ra / / byas la/ dga' ba'i tshig 'jam po 'khrig tshigs sna tshogs dang byas shing dga' dga' ltar byed pa dang*/ glu gar sogs rol mo dang*/ / gong du bshad pa ltar phan tshun 'khyud dang tsum pa ste'o gdab pa dang*/ ta nu 'drud// pa ste mkhur bshud dang*/ / ze 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'dab ldan te pad+ma shing bu dang sor mo lce dang rdo rje nor bu rdzas kyi sbyor ba dang bcas pas pad+ma'i phyi nas bsnye ba dang 'tshab pa dang nang du dkrug cing*/

bskul ba yis/ / shes rab ma lus 'dar zhing g.yo dang 'dod pa rgyas pa'i shugs kyis sems brtan cing khengs pa nyams pa dang*/ dga' bar ste 'dod pa spyod pa rengs/ / pa dang*/ chags pa'i bde ba skyes pa'i rtags su mig zim zim du zim par 'gyur ba dang de skabs su rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid kyi nyams myong la/ / 'khyud pa sogs lus kyi las mang yang 'bras bu bde ba cung zad tsam ma gtogs chung bas/ / gang reg pa'i cha shas la bde ba skye ba dga' ba dang po 'a ོ / / steng gdong dang 'og tu rdo rje pad+ma la rnam par bltas nas/ / g.ya' chu'i brlan dang bcas pad+ma rtsa longs shing cud zad kha phye ba rab rgyas par/ /rdo rje 'phrang zhing rgyas pa rab tu bcug pa 'i dal bus skyod cing 'jug pa'o/ / sa/ / shes rab ma'i lus 'dar ba dang dbugs dang skad rngam zhing 'gyur dang sīta kyi sgra/ / te 'khun cing so bar nas dbugs grang mo mngon pa'o/ / u yig ni sgra gsang ba mthon por mkhyug pa'o/ / drod bcas ni lus la drod skyes pa'o/ / sgra nyams pa/ / te tshig 'bru mi 'gyur ba dang chags pa'i ngag tshig mi go bar smra ba'o/ /de ltar bu mos ye shes thob par 'gyur te/ / thabs rang nyid la lus kyi rtsol ba chen po bral zhing lus thams cad la khyab pa'i bde ba rim gyis bde khril khril skye ba ni/ /mchog tu dga' bar yang dag brjod/ / dbang po gnyis rab tu bskyod cing pho mo gnyis can gyis bskyod pa las/ / rig ma bde ba mi bzod pas ngu ba'am dga' bdes rgod shor ba dam byis pa'i tshul/ / ltar gtam cal col smra ba'o/ / 'dod pa 'am bde ba sa mi bzod cing gzhan gang yang mi dran pas dran pa nyams pa/ / dang*/ thabs bdag gis ye shes ni lus sems bde zhing gsal stong gi nyams 'byung ba/ / sems spros pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba 'di lhan skyes kyi dga'/ / ba yin/ thig le 'dzag pas bde ba nyams pa bral ba'i dga' ba de lta bu spangs nas/ /ye shes te stong pa la snyam par bzhag pa dang*/

dmigs pa mchog gis thig le dgag par bya/ /yang na de tsam gyis bkag mi thub na btsan thabs sbyor bas 'gag par bya'o/ /bkag pa'i thig le zin pa'i rtags rdo rje ches 'phrang zhing sbom par 'gyurab dang*/ nor bu na thang ba dang*/ bde ba sbring shes gnas pa 'byung*/ de nas thig le drangs pas so/ /rdo rje thugs hril gyis 'khums dang chu skyes te bha ga kha rus kyi zum/ / pa dang*/ thabs kyi lus stong par sang gi song ba snyam byed pas/ da ltar bde ba gsal po med kyang sngar gyi bde ba rjes dran bral ba'i dga'/ / ba'o/ /mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi dga' bral du bsdus/ yas brtan dga' bzhi yang gzhan gsum du bsdus pa'o/ /lnga pa sbyor thabs bshad pa ni/ phyag rgya la 'khrig thabs mchog tu bcings pa rnam pa bdun/ / gyis skyod ste/ thabs kyi phrag par phyag rgya mo'i rkang pa 'di la g.yas 'gel ba dang*/ g.yon 'gel ba dang*/ gnyis kar 'gel ba'i sbyor bas gsum mo/ / zung ster ba dang*/ /steng nas phal ba ltar chags pa spyod pa dang shes rab ma glo g.yas dang*/ thabs g.yon 'og tu phab ste sbyor ba dang*/ de nyid go bzlog ste 'khrig pa ni/ 'og dang thad ka rdo rje sems dpa'i byed pa ste dkyil dkrungs bcas nas shes rab ma spang du blangs te spyod pa'o/ / rgyab/ / nas dud 'gro ltar spyod pa'o/ / shin tu brkyang ba ni 'jig rten pa ltar spyod pa las thabs kyi rkang ba gnyis brkyang ba'o/ / dang bsnol ba ni phal pa ltar ram thad ka ltar yang rung ste/ thabs kyi g.yas shes rab kyi sked la mkhyud na shes rab ma'i g.yas kyang thabs la mkhyud pa dang*/ yang de nyid go bzlog pa/ gyin gor sogs/ 'o/ /rdzas kyis thig le 'phel ba 'i rim gror byas/ / ye shes skyed pa'i thabs nor bu bstan pa ni/ cha ga ba'i sbyor ba sogs skye gnas dam por 'gro ba dang tsha ba ra 'gro ba yis yis/ / sman gyi sbyor ba thams cad bya bar bya/ / dgos pa ni 'di yis

bde ba'i ye shes te bde bas gnas lugs rtogs pa rgyas par 'gyur/ / ba yin no/ /drug pa rjes chags dngos grub kyi rgyur nges par dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ zhing rnams na gnas pa'i bud med te zhing skyes dang las skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams/ /'dod chen chags pa'i sbyor bas g.yog tu bkol ba mnan bya sa pas dgyes par 'gyur yis/ /me tog sogs kyis mchod pa tsam la mi dgos/ / shes pa te mi dog sogs mi dgos pa'i don min rjes chags dgos pa'i don yin no/ / sbyor ba gang gis rdo rje 'phrang zhing rgyas pa dang*/ /pad+ma 'i rtsa sad cing rtsa rna nar zhing lug par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'gram dang bya lce rgyas par 'gyur pa 'i rdzas sbyor de bsten bya/ / bdun pa gsang ba'i bcud len la gnyis las/ so skyes lam gyi skabs ni chu skyes dbus su sems phyung la/ /de yi ye shes lhan skyes dga' bral dang bcas pa mtshon par byas nas/ /me tog shes rab ma'i rak+tas bcas pa 'i rang gi thig le lid+gas btung*/ /ra sa ya bcud len ṇa'i 'a grel chen las ni/ ra rā ga chags pa/ sa satwa snying stobs/ ya yo ni skye gnas/ ṇa kā ru ṇa/ snying rje ste snying rje'i skye gnas snying stobs kyi chags par bde ba'o/ / 'phags lam gyi sa bcu'i skabs ni rab tu dga' sogs gnas byas nas/ / te/ sa de dag la gnas pa'i 'phags pa rnams thig le rags pa ni dag zin pas/ de'i 'gyur ba med kyang sems kyi snang ba tsam bde ba'i gtan gyi thig le 'gro 'ong byed pa'i 'gyur bar ston/ / cing de yang rang dbang du gyur pa'i 'gro 'ong yin pa'i phyir ston ces so/ /de skabs kyi spyod pa'i skabs 'gar thabs khu ba phyed shes rab kyi pad+mar 'ongs nas kyi shes rab ma'i/ / rtsa 'khor lo so so 'gro 'ong byas pas rtsa sad par byed/ / de yang shes rab ma'i gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i phyed thabs shes kyi dkar chag dmar 'dres pa phyed kyis gang zhing khyab la brtan par byas/

phyed kyis thabs kyi gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i phyed brtan gang khyab par byas pas sa dang po sbyang ngo*/ /de bzhin du gsang 'khor phyed gcig shos kyis sa gnyis pa dang*/ des mtshon lte ba la cha gnyis kyis gsum pa bzhi pa/ snying kha la cha gnyis kyis lnga pa drug pa/ mgrin pa cha gnyis kyis bdun pa brgyad pa/ spyi bo la cha gnyis kyis dgu pa bcu pa/ spyi gtsug la cha gnyis kyis bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa sbyong ngo*/ /de thams cad kyang*/ gang khyab brtan grub pa'i dbang du byas kyis spyir spyi bor brtan pa'i bar shes rab dang po'i gnyis ka la drag tu dgos shing*/ 'di'i rtsa thig gnyis kar rags pa min/ ye shes snang ba tsam yin la/ thabs kyi byang sems/ shes rab kyi 'khor lo so sor 'di bar spyod/ 'od zer spro bsdu lta bu yin no/ /brgyad pa chags lam gyi mthar thug sa bcu gnyis pa mngon du byed tshul ni/ gzugs mdzes pa la ltas pa'i bde ba'i 'bras bu sa dang po dang dga' ba'i sgra/ / nyan pa'i 'bras bu sa gnyis pa dang*/ / dri mnam pas bde ba la sems zin pa'i 'bras bu sa gsum pa dang*/ ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi btung*/ / ba ro la sems zin pa'i 'bras bu sa bzhi pa dang*/ 'o dang mkhyud pa sogs phyi'i reg bya'i bde ba la sa lnga pa dang gnyis gnyis sprod pa rags pas thob pa'i bde ba la sa drug pa dang*/ /rdo rje drag tu bslang ba bha ga yis/ /'tshir ba reg pa sra ba sa bdun pa dang rdo rje pad+ma'i zil pas gsher ba chu khams kyi bde ba la sa brgyad pa dang*/ / gsang gnas sogs su drod skye ba me khams kyi bde ba la sa dgu pa dang g.yo ba rlung khams kyi bde ba la sa bcu pa rnam shes gsum/ / <slob pa bcu gnyis ltar na snang mched thob pa dang bcu bzhi ltar na snang gsum 'phral ba'o > ste snang mched thob gsum sa bcu gcig pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa sangs rgyas so/ /de dag la rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sar brjod

cing ngo bo gzhan du bshad pa/ / ni sa bcu pa'i mdo sogs chos kyi phung po zab mo rin chen gyi snod dang 'dra ba'i nang du sbas/ / so/ /dgu pa lam gyi thog mtha' gnyis su nges par phyag rgya bsdus tshul ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rnyed pa la las rgya la ma brten pa'i ye shes yod kyang*/ rdzogs rim bde ba la'am/ snang ba gsum la'am/ dga' bzhi la'am/ sems la dmigs pa la/ dang po'i las can gyi don te bskyed rim sogs dang spyi mdog nas mi sbyor te rnams la ni/ /bud med spangs pas rang lus tsam gyis snang ba gsum dang*/ dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa rdzogs par skyed pa'i ye shes med/ /dang po de skyed pa dang tha mar sangs rgyas thob ka gnyis kar du gnyis sbyor gyi lam la brten bas/ /sangs rgyas kyi bde ba chen po'i sku rab tu 'grub/ / po/ /bcu pa dgos pa can gyi dmigs gsal ni nus pa dang bral ba ste ma thob pa'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i dbang gong ma can gyi dbang bskur ba/ / na/ lhan skyes mtshon zin na/ pad+mar sems ni mngon par dbab pas/ /bde gshegs mchod par 'gyur ba'i cho ga bya ba nyid/ / la ni nyes pa med do/ /ces pa'o/ / me'i nyi mas/ slob dpon nus bral gyis gsang dbang bskur ba la/ thig le brtan par byed ma nus kyang dgos pa'i dbang gis so zhes 'chad do/ /dus gzhan du byang chub kyi sems byung na dngos grub ring*/ / te thob dka'/ bcu gcig pa bud med gtso bor gyur pa'i rjes chags sgom tshul la sngon 'gro ni bud med dag kyang rjes chags kyi lam 'dis grol bar 'gyur te/ / de yang bud med nyid gtso bo'i tshe rtsa sbyangs pa'i skabs/ sor mo dang shing dang lpags pa yis/ /'khrul 'khor dag gis rtsa sad par bya/ / la dga' bzhi rjes mthun bsgom nus pa'i tshe/ dgos kyi thabs nus ldan ni nges par brten la/ nus bral yang sgrub tu rung ba'i skabs yod de/ thabs kyi rim ma bzhin no/

/skyes pa bcu drug ma lon pa dang drug cu rgal ba bde ba'i don du mi brten skad dgos pa ni/ 'dod chags chen po lam du byed par dga' ba'i bud med rnams gtso bor rab tu grol ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnams rgyas par phye/ / ba yin te/ chags chen spang ba dang*/ ye shes su 'khyer mi nus pa la ma yin cing*/ bud med kyang mi mo kho na la mi sbyor gyi 'gro ba'i rigs kun la yod do/ /bud med ches dbang po rno bar bstan pa ni bde ba skyed byed kyi bdun cu gnyis/ / ni/ skyes bu la med pa bud med rnams kyi lhag pa'i rtsa/ / yin te/ rtsa nyer bzhi las / rlung khrag khu ba 'bab pa shin tu phra ba re re dbu ma la 'khril shing*/ gsum ka la brgyad brgyad phye ste/ kha dang*/ nu ma dang*/ gsang gnas gsum du zug pa'o/ /lte bar thams cad yal ga 'brel/ kun gyi sne spyi bor zug pa'o/ /rab tu dbang du byas la khu ba'i rtsa nyer bzhi med pa 'bring*/ rlung rkyang nyer bzhi las med na tha ma ste/ de dag gi bar mtshams mang nyung ci rigs pa yod cing*/ rtsa de dag gi yan lag ji tsam mang gin bzang bar bshad do/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir nges par 'bad pas chags chen gyi lam 'dir zhugs na/ bud med myur du byang chub thob pa/ / tsam skyes bu ste skyes pa de bzhin du myur ba min pa nyid/ / do/ /bcu gnyis pa rab byung gi chags lam sgom pa nyes pa med par bstan pa 'phros dang bcas pa ni 'du shes gzhan du gyur pa lha'i 'du shes su bsgyur ba dang thig le mi 'dzag pas de'i las lam ma rdzogs dang*/ / rang bzhin med par shes bud med du 'dzin pa med pas mi dmigs pas zin pa na bde ba la sred zhen gyi chags pa mngon du rgyu med pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di las lhung ba med de/ / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ g.yem pa'i las lam rdzogs pa la 'du shes ma 'khrul dgos/ phal ba la 'du shes mi gtso bor 'dod na'ang*/

bsam pa kun slong dgos pa la med pas mthar thug ma tshang ba dang*/ spyir rang bzhin gyi nyes pa min phyin/ spong ba bdun nam bcu dang ma 'gal/ so so thar pa dang 'gal ba ma yin no/ /ces pa'i don/ de bas sems tha mal pa'i 'dod chags bcas pa ste des kun nas blangs te sad pa dang rmi lam gyi gnas skabs la/ / yid kyi bud med brten pa'i tshul min yid byed can thig le 'dzag par byed pa de dag nyes pa dang bcas/ / pa'o/ /bdun pa shes rab ma'i dam tshig dus thun bzhir phyag rgya bzang mo ste mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la 'dod pa'i dga' ba spyod/ / sgrub bya'i dam tshig rnams kyi gtso bo'i gtso/ / ste lhan skyes rtogs byed dngos yin pas so/ /thun bzhir mi 'grub na zla re'am lo ni re re ru/ /pad+ma mchod

dgos la mchod par mi byed na/ / ma nus pa tsam cung zad nyams pa yin la mi dad na de tshe dam tshig nyams pa yis/ / tsha ba chen por ni tsha dmyal dngos gzhi rnam par lhung*/ / dngos su mi nus na/ gus pas yid kyis brten nas cung zad kyang ma nyams pa'o/ / dngos grub 'dod pas mi dang mi min gyi bud med kun/ / zas gos/ rjes chags dmigs pa gang 'os kyis mchod cing gus pas dngos sam yid kyis phyag bya'o/ / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi dud 'gro mo la'ang gus bya dgos na/ /mi mo la ci phyir gus mi byed/ / spyir bud med thams cad ni shes rab kyi phyogs yin pa dang*/ shes rab bde stong skyed pa'i gzhi yin pas na shes rab nyid bud med mi mo'i gzugs/ / su bstan ces pa'o/ khyad par bla ma dang*/ bla ma'i rdo rje'i dbu rgyan/ btsun mo ni/ ma dang rang gi rdo rje'i sring mo slob ma bud med ni bu mo dang / / yang na sngon gyi skye bzhin du de ltar gyur pa la 'chad pa'ang yod/ rang gis sgrub par bya ba sgrol ma sogs/ / lha dang ye shes skyed byed kyi bla ma dang ye shes kyi grogs su gyur pa/ / bdag la rab tu byams pa ldan pa gnyen gshin cing nye ba yin pa la/ / der mi shes shing byas pa mi gzo bas/ / bud med 'di dag skye pa bas skye gnas dman ces rnam smod pa/ / ni rtsa ltung 'byung bas/ nad bad kan sogs dang rims 'og nad 'byung tshe thung ba dang*/ / shi nas dmyal bar nges par 'tshed pa 'gyur/ / ro/ /dam tshig mi shes zhing blun pa'i sngags pa gang rnal 'byor ma rgyud du zhugs nas bud med la/ / sdang sems dang smad sems kyis snun par byed na lha'i dam tshig kun nyams pas/ / 'phral du bka' chad kyi sdug bsngal 'byung bas skad cig de la zhes smos la rtsa ltung lci ba 'byung bas mnar med du ltung*/ / ngo*/ /dper na bu mo spun gnyis shin tu nye ba zhig yod la/ nu mo la dgra byas na/

thu mo la mchod kyang thu mo dga' bar mi 'gyur ba ltar/ mi mo smad na/ lha mo rnams mchod kyang mi dgos/ ces pa ni/ yid du sdug pa'i spun gyi dgrar gyur gyur ba'i mi dpe na/ /spun zla gcig shos de mchod kyang mi de las dgar mi 'gyur*/ / ba bzhin/ sgrub po bud med la smod pa rnams la ye shes kya ི lha mo rnams/ /mi dges zhing de yi mchod pa yang mi len/ / no/ /de yang bud med thams cad ye shes kyi lha mo'i rigs su gnas pa'o/ /brgyad pa dga' ba med pa'i lam du bshad pa ni/ don gnyis las/ dang po don dngos ni/ mdo lam du zhugs nas bskal ba bye ba grangs med par/ / sbyin pa tshul khrims sogs bzang por spyod pa kho nas kyang*/ / bla na med pa'i byang chub rin chen ma thob pa/ / gang la phyag rgya gsum gyi 'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ / las dang po gcig kyang tshe 'di nyid kyis byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / ba ni dam tshig skyed rim bzlas pa stong nyid rdzas sogs yan lag phra mo mang du yod mod/ / rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi don stong nyid bsgom zhing*/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam bcas dang sbyor ba 'i bde ba rab sgrub pa/ / de las rnam med zhor la 'byung zhing*/ bogs 'don/ bud med kyi sbyor ba las phyag rgya che/ / dngos po'i gnas lugs rang bzhin lhan skyes mngon du yang yang mtshon par byed na rnal 'byor pa de/ sa chu sogs khrus dang dkar gsum sogs gtsang sgra mi dgos shing*// bsnyungs ba dang mi smra ba sogs dka' spyad bud med sogs 'dod yon bkag pa'i sdom pa byin pa med par yang*/ / lus ngag bde ba nyid dang sems dga' ba <kho na3gt; sa 'grub/ / po/ / de bas na nang snang thams cad sems bde stong rnam rol sgyu ma ltar shes pas ci ltar 'dod pa ltar bud med spyod cing*/ / gtsang mi gtsang kun bzang de bzhin glu gar dang bcas bsnyon spyod sogs spyod pa nges med thams cad spyod/ / la/ lus ngag yan lag ces 'grel pa gnyis 'chad kyang*/

sems kyi g.yo ba rnams kyang mi dgag pa ste/ / g.yo ba dag kyang ci dgar byed/ / spyod pa ji lta bu bya sa kyang te rtog ge pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi spyod pa sogs kyis kyang rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ / ro/ /sku 'dra gzugs brnyan lugs ma la sogs bris sku la blta ba sogs las/ / lha sku'i rnal 'byor yang dag pa skye bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /byang chub sems bde stong la rab tu brtson na/ /de las rnal 'byor rnam rtog gis ma brtags pa'i lha sku ra 'gyur ro/ / phra thig gam kha sbyor gyi sku la brten nas zhu ba'i bde stong cung zad shar ba na/ rdzogs pa'i lha sku rjes mthun pa 'grub/ zhu bde mthar thug na sgyu lus/ rang bzhin lhan skyes shar ba'i tshe/ zung 'jug gi lha 'grub pa dang*/ de dag tu sku rang shar dpag tu med par 'byung ngo*/ /lus kyi g.yo ba dang ngag smra ba dang spyod pa 'phral gyi bya ba kun/ / bde stong des zin na rim pa ji lta ba bas/ phyag rgya dang sngags dang cho gar 'gyur/ / ro/ / gnyis pa las rgya'i dgos pa ni/ 'di'i dka' gnas ni/ pha rol phyin pa la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs na las rgya nges par mtshon dgos pa ci zhes pa'o/ /'dir tshe gcig la stong nyid rtogs pa la nges par dgos/ chos dbyings mthar thug rtogs pa la nges par dgos te mod la de rtogs pa med lam 'dir zhugs pa la/ mthong lam thob pa la yang*/ las rgya sngon 'gro can nges par dgos pa yin no/ /ces pa 'di nges dgos so/ /nor bu 'dod pas thog mar mun khrod kyi nor bu lag nom mi byed par mar me legs par blangs nas ni/ /mun pa'i khrod na gnas pa'i nor bu mun pa gsal te len/ / pa bzhin du/ chos dbyings lhan skyes bde chen rtogs pa'i don du yin yang thog mar de'i rnam pa yid la mi byed par/ bde ba la rmongs shing chags pa'i sgrib pa'i mun par chos kyi dbyings/ / nub pa sel ba'i phyir/ bde ba drag tu skyed nas de la mi chags par stong pa bsres/

mi rtog pa 'char thub pa'i bud med las rgya'i bde ba rnyed na de sa chos dbyings 'tshol bar bya/ / ste/ rtogs pa'i thabs la 'jug go /'o na thub pas theg pa 'og mar mi ston pa ci snyam na gang zhig gang dang*/ shin tu nye bar gnas pa rnams/ /de dang de'i chos la mi gus pa/ / yin te/ nor bu'i gling na gnas pa rnams nor bu rin thang chung ba rtsi ba bzhin du/ 'jig rten gsum na bud med dang rtag tu 'grogs shing 'dzag bdes skye bo thams cad 'khol bas/ chags lam bstan na dkon par mi sems la/ 'dzag bde dang mi 'gyur ba'i dbye ba mi shes pas bzang por mi brtsi ste/ thar ba dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ mtho ris thams cad la sgrib pa'o snyam du byung ba/ mkhyen nas rgyal ba shākya thub pa sogs kyi gdul bya thun mongs thams cad la sa chags bral gyi lam bstan/ /dam pa'i don te dngos gnas du chags bral gyi lam de kho na nyid mthar thug min/ / pas na/ chags bral gyi lam la blo goms 'dod chags dang srings pa chags lam la dgos pa'i nus pa skye/ 'dod chags kyi nyes dmigs dang skyon dang gnas tshul dang nges pas 'dzag bde dang mi 'gyur bde ba'i skyon yon tan khyad par thams cad phye ba'i skabs/ slar yang chags chen gyi lam bstan te mthar thug la 'jog go /dgu pa rig pa'i brtul shugs ni/ yang gsungs pa/ don lnga pas/ dang po gsang spyod ni dang por mtshan mas dben pa'i dus rang khyim lam dur khrod sogs su gsangs te spyad/ / dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya bcas pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs/ sems brtan pa dang lhag par brtan/ zla gcig zla drug sogs spyad par bya ste lhag par bogs thon gyi bar du bya'o/ / gal te skabs der sems mi brtan na/ / re zhig spyod pa bya ma ran pa yin pas bsdus nas nang du rtag tu mnyam par 'jog kyang phyir/ tha mal pa'i tshul du rol/ / ba'o/ /gnyis pa smyon spyod ni/ de gzhan na dus gzhan du skye bo'i mngon du

smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ / don du lha'i chas su 'gyur kyang mis de ltar mi shes pa rtsa ba 'bras bu phreng bas brgyan pa sogs byas yid mi 'gyur bar/ sha za bzhin du nyin mtshan kun tu 'khyam/ / gsum pa kun bzang gi spyod pa ni/ gter dang gnod sbyin mo sogs rdzu 'phrul dang 'jig rten pa'i mngon shes lnga grub pas/ / smyon pas spyod pa bskus/ rnal 'byor par khas blangs te 'jig rten pa'i mngon du yang dag par spyad/ / do/ /bzhi pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa ni/ gal te rab dga' sogs 'phags pa'i sa thob na/ / rang nyid nyon mongs mtha' dag las rgyal ba yin pas/ des ni bdud kyi phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i spyod/ / de yang rang gi nyon mongs las ma rgyal bas pham pa srid de/ 'dod chags las ma rgyal bas/ dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba'i spyod pa ston mi nus pa sogs sbyar ro/ /sa thob na nyon mongs ma spangs kyang*/ de las nges par rgyal ba ni yin no/ /spyod pa de dag kyang*/ zhing rnams kun tu rgyu ba'am/ / ma rgyu/ yang na bas mtha ra gnas pa 'am rang gi khyim/ / tu gnas nas sbas pa'i spyod pa byas pa sa kyang grol bar 'gyur/ / ro/ /lnga pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i spyod pa ni yang na tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bya te/ / sgrub po phyag rgya lhan cig spyod ma dang bcas dbus su 'dug rjes 'brang 'khor nyung mtha' bud med bcu gnyis ni las bzhi/ rigs bzhi sgo ma bzhi mtshon pa rnams dang*/ rnam rol pa/ / lha'i gos rgyan dang gdong te 'bag sogs rnam par brgyan/ / nas/ bskyed rim mam rdzogs rim don la gnas pa'am/ sgyu las sam/ zung 'jug gi skabs 'khor so so'i skyed chog gi /dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i mthar shar gyi bud med dbus su 'ongs shing*/ /gcig shos dbus ma shar du gnas nas 'dod yon la dges rol sogs/ / de bzhin du lho phyogs ma sogs bcu gnyis pa thams cad la rjes sogs bya ba yin/

su ma li ta/ rab ral la'ang 'gro mod/ 'grel ba gnyis ltar bshad do/ /glu dang glu lan sogs gar dang gar lan phyag dang phyag lan/ dha dang dha lan/ phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan sogs sna tshogs pa du mas rnam par rol rtsed bya ba/ / ste gnas skyed mos tshal la sogs par chu tshon gyi dkyil 'khor byas nas bsgrub/ /glu dang zlos gar phal pa kun yang yid bzhin du ma gyur par byas te/ / tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor der slob ma dbang bskur ba dang zhi rgyas sogs las kun yang sgrub par bya/ / 'o/ /bcu pa btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba ni/ yang gsungs pa/ 'di la drug ste/ man ngag ltar rdo rje'i sgo ni dbye ba dang*/ /de bzhin pad+ma rgyas par dbye/ / ba ni 'grel bar rtsa skyed cing tshol ba bshad/ rtsa sgo dbye ba'ang yin no/ /lag len ltar shing ngam sa yi 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /bshang ba'i lam du rtse bar bya/ (1) / ste thur sel sbyor ba'o/ / srog gi rlung dang de bzhin du thur du sel ba 'a ི / / rlung bum pa can gyis bkag cing gong bu gcig tu bya/ (2) / te/ bum can gyi yan lag gzhan gyis srog thur bsre ba'ang bya'o/ /rim ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' bas 'dod yon lnga la/ rol pa la zhugs nas/ / dbang po gnyis dal bu dal bus rab tu sbyor zhing srub te/ / bshang lam gyi sgo dbye ba dang (3) rtsa bcing ba sor mos gnon/ (4) /bu mos rtsa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug yi thur ma thabs kyi gsang ba'i sgor bcug pa yis/ / thabs kyi dhū ti rnam par kha 'byed par 'gyur/ / dbu ma'i mas sna de yi gnas su tshangs pa'i rlung rgyas te/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo so sor slen pa na kun kyang rgyas shing mdud pa kha phye la sad pa ra / / 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad par rlung des gtum mo 'bar ba bcas par 'gyur zhing des snying kha nas spyi bo'i bar gyi thig le zhu zhing 'dzag (5) /btsan thabs sbyor bas te gtum mo mi dmigs dang bum can drag pos lte ba gtum mo'i

me dngos su 'bar (6) ba/ / na/ thog mar dbu ma'i mdud pa dgos pas 'bar ba 'gro mi nus par/ rwa sa na las me rnam par rgyu/ / 'o/ /me de spyi bor sleb nas kyang*/ spyi bo'i haṃ zhu nas/ 'dzag pa 'a ི rgyun dbu ma nas mi thub par 'ang la la na las 'ba' te/ rim pa lo zla tsam na lte bar phyin pa'i tshe khu ba de dang lte ba'i gtum mo dbu mar 'dres par gyur pa na kun 'dar gyi nang du/ / gtum mo 'bar bar byed cing*/ snying kha sogs rtsa 'khor lo dang 'khor lo so so la/ /lan mang po ste lan gsum gsum bzlog cing re re yang yang 'bar gnas/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nga ste rtsa 'khor lte ba'i steng 'og gi rtsa mdud rnams 'bigs par byed*/ / do/ /'bar ba de las spyi bo'i thig le zhu mgrin snying dang 'dres te lte ba'i gtum mo/ / rnam par ltung ba yis/ / rang lus kyi lhan skyes skye bas chos kyi phyag rgya mi rtog pa'i bde stong rab tu 'grub/ / po/ bcu gnyis pa mngon par byang chub pa bshad pa ni/ don drug las/ dang po cho ga ni mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pas rab tu bshad pa ra / / bya ste byang chub rim pa gong 'og gnyis ka la/ 'byung ba bzha ི'i bde ba lha mo bzhi ra rab tu brtag/ cing sgom te sa sra ba'i bde ba'i tshe phyag rgya spyan ma sogs sbyor shing*/ de yang mthong lam du 'byung ba'i bde ba rang dang rgyun mthar rnam pa mthun pa tsam mo/ /gnyis pa yul ni/ mi skyod he ru ka'i rigs dang rnam snang gi gdol ba ma bram ze'i bu mo dang*/ / rin 'byung gi tshong pa'i bu mo dang*/ 'od dpag med kyi glu mkhan bu mo dang*/ mda' mkhan mo/ / gnyis dang*/ las kyi rigs gar mkhan mo sogs so so'i rigs can sgrub pos bzung*/ / dgos so/ / yang na thig le mchog ma sogs rig 'dzin gyi lha mo dang mi'am ci/ / mo dang*/ klu mo dang dri za mo sogs la bsgom zhing brtag / go /yul 'di dag mngon par byang chub pa mthong lam skabs gtso che bar shes so/

/gsum pa ji ltar grol ba'i tshul ni/ thabs kyi thig le dkar cha zhu ba zla ba'i gzugs/ / las byang chub pa dang*/ shes rab ma'i me tog dang bcas spyi bor thim pa ni nyi ma las byang chub pa gsol/ / zhing longs spyod pa'o/ /des thabs dang shes rab kyi chos mtha' dag ro gcig pa mngon du gyur pa/ dang*/ des khu ba khrag thim zhing*/ de'i skad cig gnyis pa de dag dang rlung dang bcas pa'i/ / tshogs pa thams cad dus 'dir ni rnam par zhig / te/ de yan chad lus sems so sor snang yang 'di nas bzung*/ lus dang sems zhes bya ba 'i dbye ba las 'das/ /kun gzhi

rnam shes/ gnas rnam par gyur pa nyid/ / yin la/ bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ thabs 'di las longs spyod rdzogs sku thob par 'gyur/ / ro/ /'di ni rgyun mtha'i dbang du byas pas/ khu rdul rlung gi tshogs pa phra mo de/ slob pa'i ye shes kyi snang cha tsam yang 'gag tshul yin la/ mthong lam du khu rdul rlung tha mal pa 'gag gnyis su zhen pa spangs/ so so skye bo'i lus sems las 'das kun gzhi gzhan du cung zad 'gyur/ 'phral du zung 'jug 'grub pas 'di dang cha 'dra ba yin no/ /lnga pa mngon byang gi tshul gzhan ni/ yang na sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang slar rgya tshul ston pa gzhon nu/ don grub kyi rnam 'phrul sgyu ma bzhin/ / du/ yul phyag rgya gdod nas grub pa'i gshegs ma/ mā ma ki sogs la rab tu sbyor ba rgyun mtha' 'di dngos mang ngo gsungs/ drug pa kha sbyor gyi yan lag bshad pa ni 'o/ /sangs rgyas rang nyid rang snang ye shes kyi gzugs can ni/ / ye shes kyi rig ma lha mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rnam pa can 'dod chags che na / / po bde bas thugs gang ba'o/ / 'on kyang gzhan ngor snang ba ni mos pa tha dad pa'i phyir/ /sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i tshul can mig 'phrul bzhin du rnam par 'phrul/ / bar mdzad do/ /de yang ma dag pa'i zhing dang*/ sprul sku'i zhing khams dag zhing rnams su mos pa tha dad mthun par ston pa dang*/ longs sku nges pa lnga ldan gyi dngos kyi 'khor la mos pa rnam pa tha dad med kyang de la ltos pa cung zad smin ma smin yang yod la khyad par sprul sku'i mdzad pa thams cad kyi rgyu'i rnam rol 'og min du des ston pas gzhan snang gnyis ka sna tshogs pa'o/ / yang gsungs pa/ 'di nas sbyin pa'o bar dbang gi cho ga'i 'phros te rtsa rgyud le'u gsum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /zhes par kha skang ngo*/ /rdo rje gri gug ster ba'i sngags/ oṃ karti ka sarba mā ra ṇaṃ maṃ sa karta ya karta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje thod pa ster ba'i sngags ni/

oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sarba shā trun rak+ṣaṃ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mdung rtse gsum pa sbyin pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ha na ha na mā ra ya mā ra ya sarba shā trun tri shu la hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi sngags so/ / rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i dbang la sngon 'gro lus ngag yid byin gyis brlabs pa khyad par can ni gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ yi ge 'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ mtshan ma phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor dag /dkyil 'khor sku gzugs kyi bdag nyid gsum du nges byas pa/ / re re zhing slob dpon gyi snying ga nas byung slob ma'i snying gar bzhugs/ / par bya la/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ mtshon cha sa dbang bskur ba dang*/ phyag rgya phyag rgya lnga'am drug gis mnga' gsol ba/ phyis bkod nas/ /las bzhi sogs sgrub pa dang dngos grub brgyad sogs sgrub shig ces bkas gnang ba/ / bya'o/ /dngos sam yid kyis bu mo bcu drug lon pa lha mo byin gyis brlabs pa dag la 'khyud pa dang*/ /nu ma mnyed pa las bde thob pa 'i / / dga' ba dang po bde stong du sbyar ba lha sku yab yum snang stong ngo sprod pa slob dpon dbang bskur chen po sbyin pa'o/ / 'di nas rang rang las dang mtshungs par bya/ zhes pa'i bar lha'i 'phros te/ rtsa rgyud le'u gnyis par snying kha'i dbus nas spro bar bya zhes pa'i rgyas bshad do/ / zhi ba la sogs pa'i sgrol ma ni zhi ba'i dkar ba dang*/ rgyas pa'i ser ba dang*/ dbang gi dmar ba dang*/ drag po'i nag mo'o/ / zhi ba'i sgrol ma chu dang*/ rgyas pa'i dbang chen dang*/ dbang gi me dang*/ drag po'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams la gnas pa dang*/ bzhon pa zhi ba la ngang pa'i rgyal po gtsug phud can dang*/ rgyas pa la glang po che ser po dang*/ dbang la rta dmar po dang*/ drag po la ma he sngon po la bzhon pa'o/ /zhi ba'i lha mo ni phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa skyabs sbyin dang*/ phyag g.yon ut+pal dkar po 'dzin

pa'o/ /rgyas pa mo ni g.yas mchog sbyin dang bum pa dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang byed ma ni g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu dang g.yon rdo rje zhags pa'o/ / gsod byed ma ni g.yas ral gri dang g.yon dus kyi zhags pa nag po rdo rjes mtshan pa 'o/ /phyogs kyi re mig gi lha mo re mig gi grwa bzhir 'khod pa ni/ sangs rgyas sgrol ma dang rin chen sgrol ma dang chos kyi sgrol ma dang ni/ /rdo rje sgrol ma bsam bya ba/ / bzhi po go rim bzhin sku mdog dkar dang ser po dmar po dang*/ /dkar min te nag mo'o// phyag kyang bzhi pa ste/ / dang po gnyis kyi g.yas mchog stsol ba dang g.yon ut+pa la/ / rang rang mdog can/ 'og ma gnyis g.yas cang te g.yon de bzhin rtse gsum bsnams/ / phyi'i shar lho'i grwar zhal drug ka nag po phyag drug g.yas gsum na tho ba gsum dang*/ / g.yon gsum na zhags pa gsum bsnams pa zhabs drug pa/ /tshangs pa mnan cing 'joms pa gshin rje gshed/ / do/ /lho nub tu/ g.yas ral gri g.yon thod pas lag brel ba/ / spyan g.yas steng g.yon 'og tu gzigs pas g.yon po'i lta stangs can yin pas/ mig g.yon dbang po mi g.yo ba ni 'byung po'i rgyal po dbang ldan te dbang phyug chen po gnon/ / nub byang gi grwar/ g.yas gnyis na dbyug to dang ni pad+ma dang*/ / g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i mchog khro bo'i rgyal po pad mthar byed/ / ste rta mgrin bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ / ba ste dmar po'i sku mdog kyang ston/ g.yas na klu dang g.yon na gshin rje zhabs kyis mnan/ / byang shar gyi grwar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba khro bo rdo rje phur bu ni/ / g.yas gnyis na sna tshogs rdo rje dang rdo rje tho bar bcas/ / g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang phur bu bsnams nas ni/ / phur bu de log 'dren bdud dang bcas pa la 'debs par brtson/ / pa'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed ma gtogs pa/

dpa' bo ste khro bo 'di gsum sprin gyi mdog / ltar nag po'o/ /de dag las gzhan par rnams gang rmongs byed ma sogs rnams pho nya mo/ / te/ kha dog bzhon pa phyag mtshan nyams sogs rang rang gi las dang mtshungs par bya/ / 'o/ /shes rab kyi dum bu dang*/ 'di'i bar ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel mtha' gcod can rang yin pas phyi ma'i rgyud tshig gal che shos rnams so/ /dbang rim gnyis spyod pa sogs/ gsang ba thams cad 'byung pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // le'u lnga pas don bsdu ba la gsum las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de nas 'khor rnams kyis bstod pa/ lam dang dbang gi sgo nas bstod pa kun rdzob kyi thabs shes sam/ don dam gyi bden pa'i bden gnyis sam/ spyi don ltar na yul dang rnam shes kyi dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba gang*/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rim pas stong pa gsum mam kun rdzob spangs pa'am/ gzung 'dzin bral ba bdag nyid de/ /ye shes 'di ni nyon mongs 'joms pa'i phyir/ mtshon cha ste ye shes lnga rjes chags dang stong sgo la sbyar ba'i lam dus kyi ye shes rnam 'chang ba/ / nyon mongs la mngon par spyod pa brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs sna tshogs pa gcod par mdzad pa po/ / zhes 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ ma mo mkha' 'gro ma 'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i 'gro ba'i yid sgrib gnyis las skyobs pa'i phyir sngags can ma/ / te/ yang na gsung rdo rje yin pa te longs sku bstan la/ dbang po'i dra ba ni sgyu ma ste de dang 'dra bar sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing 'khrug / sa ste sprul sku bstan/ yang na dbang po'i dra ba ni dbang po thams cad pa ste rang snang gi sprul sku 'od zer gzhan snang gi sprul sku'o/ / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa mdzes ma dang gtsugs par mdzad/ / pa ste bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ / ji lta dang ji snyed gzigs pa'i blo gros chen pos ni chos sku ste de lta bus

bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /ces gsol ba btab par gyur pa las/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid kyi sku la yongs su zhugs te/ ni sngon byung yin la rjes 'jug ltar na gsang dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ de ltar slob mas gsol ba btab pa la slob dpon rig mar bcas pa'i de bzhin sgom pa'i don no/ / byang chub sems zhu zhing 'khor lo bzhir rim pas rnam par dbab pa gnas so sor mi 'gyur bcing nas dga' bzhi dngos bzung shing brtan par byed dgos pa rdo rje ste dpe nam mkha'i khams thams cad sngon byung sgra ji bzhin pa dang rjes 'jug la mkha' khams gsang ba'i pad+ma yin pas phyag rgya'i de nyid/ yongs su gang bas/ sems can kyang sngon byung sgra ji bzhin pa dang*/ rjes 'jug ltar na slob ma'i phung khams/ thams cad mchog tu ྄bde ba grub pa ni slob mas byang sems myangs pas bde ba khyad par can skye ba ra gyur to/ / gsum pa de kho na nyid bshad pa bcu gsum las/ dang po bdud gzhom pa'i sbyor ba ni/ rab tu dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /hūṃ gi yi ge la sa srung 'khor sgoms te bdud rnams gzhom/ / pa'i cho ga sgrub ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa mngon par byang chub lnga'i dag 'bras ni/ ā li mtshon byed oṃ dang kā li mtshon byed āḥ ste nyi zla'i sa bon no/ / ā li kā li ni/ nyi zla'i mtshan ma ste/ /rtsa gnyis las rkyang ma zla ba dang ro ma nyi ma dag / rnam par dag pa ste/ de ltar nyi zla kha sbyor/ de dag me long ye shes kyi dag pas rnam par dag pa te/ /sa bon dang phyag mtshan mtshan mar gyur pa ni/ /so sor rtog pa 'i ye shes kyi dag sa ra ngas bshad do/ / nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan thams cad gcig tu gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi dag pa yin te/ / 'od zer spro bsdus 'gro don byed pa ni bya ba nan tan/ / gyis ye shes kyi dag pa'o/

/gtso mo'i gzugs brnyan zhal phyag sogs yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi dag pa so/ / gsum pa bsgo bya lam dngos ni/ lha yab yum dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi rnam pa can te kha sbyor gyi sku can dang*/ rdo rje gsum/ / byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ de dngos su med kyang*/ lha bsgom sngags bzlas stong nyid gsum tshang bas rdo rje gsum lam byed nges par tshang bas/ yan lag rab tu rdzogs pa ni sngags rnams kun gyi lha 'a ི / / rnal 'byor thams cad la tshang pa dgos/ zhes pa ste/ theg pa bla na med pa 'di'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /lam thams cad bsdu na/ gsang ba bskyed rim dang gsang ba chen po rdzogs rim dang shin tu gsang*/ / ba spyod pa gsum du 'dus so/ /rnal 'byor bskyed rim dang*/ rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po lhan skyes ji bzhin mtshon nus pa'i rang lus kyi rdzogs rim dang*/ /rjes su rnal 'byor stong pa nyid shas che ba'i ting nge 'dzin sngags kyi sbyor ba can rnams dang shin tu rnal 'byor las rgya dang ye rgya'i gsang ba dang*/ / 'di bzhi po yang nang tshan bzhi bzhi dbye bas bcu drug po de dag dang*/ stong pa gzhi 'i ye shes bsdu na snang mched thob pa rnam pa gsum po/ / dang 'brel ba sngags kyi sbyor ba ni/ sngags kyi rgyud kun gyi ni gtso bo'i gtso/ / bla med kyi theg pa'i lam dang*/ de dag ston byed kyang de'i rgyud du btags so/ /mi shigs pa snying kha'i thig le dang sngags kyi thig le rlung ste sna rtser sgom pa dang rdzas/ / kyi thig le nor bur gnas pa ste/ thig le gsum du ngas rgyud rgyas pa'am gzhan du bshad de/ / bde stong gi ngang las shar zhing de'i nyams dang ma bral ba'i bskyed rdzogs yin la/ dngos gnas la ma brtags par shar la rang ma yin pa la/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba dang rtog sgom kho na'i bskyed rdzogs ni yongs brtags kyi rnal 'byor

dang*/ / ma brtags par rang shar ba bde stong ngo bor dngos gnas la grub pa yongs su rdzogs pa 'i rnal 'byor te/ rnal 'byor gsum/ / mo/ /bzhi pa lam gyi sa mtshams ni/ bskyed rdzogs la gsal snang brtan po ma 'ched pa ni/ mi gsal ba 'i gnas skabs kyi gang zag dang bskyed rdzogs goms shing lha sku bde ba gang rung la gsal snang brtan cing mched pa ni ye shes chung*/ / ba'i gnas skabs dang gnyis ka la brtan cing mched pa ni ye shes gsal ba'i gnas skabs dang gnyis ka'i gsal snang rab 'byams mched pa ni ye shes chen po 'a ི gnas skabs ste/ / gnas skabs bzhi la gnas pa'i gang zag rnam pa bzhi ru brjod/ / do/ /lnga pa stong nyid lta ba'i don bsdu ni/ gzugs kyi phung po med tshor ba dang 'du shes dang*/ /'du byed dang ni rnam shes kyi phung po dang bral/ / ba te de dag min pa'o/ / dbang po dang yul dang rnam shes te khams bco brgyad med/ / cing ma yin pa dang*/ nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa med cing ma yin pa dang byang chub kyang glo bur spangs pa'i cha tsam gyis na rang bzhin la med/ / la/ dmigs yul dngos po med cing dngos med kyang med la sgom pa po dang sgom yang med/ / la/ de nyid la yon tan 'phel ba med cing skyon bri ba med/ / dngos med kyi rtag pa min la mi rtag pa yang ma yin pa/ / blo dang sgras yod pa dang med pa dang yod med gnyis yin gnyis min du gzhag rgyu med cing 'das/ / pa'o/ /don dam 'di la gang zag dang*/ chos kyi bdag med cing*/ de med pas gzhan yang med/ /bden par blos dpyad du med cing min pa dang*/ rdzun pa 'i dngos dang dngos med kyang ma yin pa/ /rkyen gyis byed pa dang 'gag pa'am rkyen la ltos nas gzhag pa'i stong pa min cing*/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nyid/ / yin pa de ni don dam pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par brjod/ / do// drug pa thabs mkhas spyod pa'i khyad par ni/ dmigs

pa 'dzin pa dang dmigs med dmigs pas bkag pa las 'das nas/ / bya spyod kun/ 'char yang 'dzin pa gdod nas/ 'char yang 'dzin pa gdod nas grol bzhin du rang gzhan gyi ye shes mchog gi rgyur / bya ba ci dgar spyod par byed pa/ / rig sngags grub pa gang yin pa'i/ / sbyor lam sa'am 'phags pa'i gnas thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thabs kyi spyod pa la gnas/ / pa'o/ /bsad skrad dbye ba sogs kyang sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa lta bu dang*/ / sangs rgyas mchod pa yang sgyu mas sgyu ma mchod byed ltar/ / ma zhen la/ don chen po sgrub cing*/ rtag tu 'khor ba dang mthun pa ltar bstan yang 'khor bas ma gos pa'i/ thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa 'di dag gis/ /rmi lam la bya byed med kyang bya byed ltar snang ba

bzhin du sngags kyi spyod pa'o/ / bdun pa las rgya'i gsang ba ni ji ltar chos nyid kyi me yis bsregs pa ltar/ / dngos po so so'i ngo bo nyid kyi mthu sa bud med dang mnyam par sbyor ba las/ / bde la mi rtog pa las shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa 'i rigs bskyed/ / bas te rlung ro rkyang gzung 'dzin gyi g.yo ba thim pa dang bde ba skye ba dang*/ /rnam rtog shugs drag ngo bo nyid kyi gcod/ / par byed do/ / de phyir bud med de la bde stong de rab tu bsgrub/ / po/ zhu bde des don dam mtha' med dbus kyang bzung du med pa rig pa/ / 'di ni don dam pa rdo rje ste mi 'gyur ba 'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / <gyi don bde ba'i snying po len pa3gt;'o/ /brgyad pa rim gnyis kyi gsang ba ni/ lhar snang gi/ rtog pa tha mal gyi sa rtog pa rnam par spangs par 'gyur te/ /de 'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom/ / par bya'o/ / 'dod chags la bde ba sgoms pas 'dod chags kyi bde ba 'od gsal nye bar 'gro ba dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhe sdang dang gti mug rnams/ /'od gsal mchog tu nye bar 'gro ba 'a ི / / lam rgyu ni/ thun mongs ma yin pa'i bde ba dang rlung sems kyi lha sku sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ / snying khar rlung sems bsdus rnam par mi rtog pa sgoms pas rnam par sbyangs/ / par bya'o/ /dgu pa lam gyi rnam bzhag ni/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa la dbye na sa bcu gnyis/ / yod pa ni ngo bo zhing gi pho nya mo dang gtso bor sbyor ba'i bde stong gi de kho na nyid dang*/ / nyer bzhi'i rtsa dang de dang de'i khams dang g.yo ba rlung gi bgrod pa yi/ / dbugs 'gro 'ong sogs 'gags pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par bcu gnyis so/ / de nas de 'i rjes thogs la ye shes zung 'jug gi sku/ / 'grub ste/ sku 'di la rtsa med khams kyang med/ /rlung gi bgrod pa'ang yod pa ma yin/ / te/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum 'gags te ye shes kyi lus ngag yid gsum thob pas so/

/ 'on kyang sems kyi rnam 'phrul tsam rtsa sogs phra mo'i snang ba ni yod te/ / sems snang gi khams dang rtsa rlung*/ de dang de 'gags pa las 'phags lam gyi sa bcu gnyis/ / 'byung ba'o/ / pho nya mo mchog rnams dang sbyor ba'i dngos grub las/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pa dang mtshungs pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po'i ngo bo 'di/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gsang sngags pa rnams kyi sa bcu gnyis zhes brjod/ / de sa'i ngo bo'o/ /bcu pa gang zag bdun bshad pa ni/ las dang po pa ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang med pa dang rnal 'byor pa gsal snang tsam skyes pa dang sgrub pa po/ / las thogs med du grub cing dngos grub 'grub tu rung ba dang*/ grub pa thun mongs che 'bring thob dang*/ mchog tu grub pa mchog gi dngos grub thob pa te sa thob pa tsam dang ni sems dpa' che na / / po ni sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad do/ / rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba ni bla med sangs rgyas te sngags spyod pa po rim pa bdun du gsungs/ / pa dang*/ brtson 'grus can la bla ma'i drin gyis skye ba gcig la bdun ka rdzogs par mngon du gyur pa'o/ / bcu gcig pa dngos po'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ gang du yang bzung rgyu kyi stong pa ma yin blo'i yul gyi rang bzhin mi stong pa'ang min/ / rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i sems 'di chos thams cad de bzhin nyid/ /nam mkha' la dbye ba med kyang*/ snod kyis dbye ba rtog ngor byed pa ltar/ / las dang po pa sogs gnas skabs bdun du de bzhin nyid mi shes pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams rtog / par byed do/ /sems kyi rdo rje rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa/ / 'khor 'das kya ི gnas skabs su theg pa 'i rim pa thug sa med pa rnams kyis/ / sems kyi dbyings de ni mi 'jig cing g.yo ba med/ / la/ nam mkha' la sa chu me rlung gang gis kyang mi gos pa lta bur chos thams cad kyis gos pa med/

/ la/ 'o na 'khor bar snang ba ci yin snyams na/ ji ltar mig rab rib can dag gis/ /nam mkha' la ni skra shad med kyang mthong / / ba/ /de bzhin du 'khor ba 'i snang ba thams cad rnam par rtog / tsam ste/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la 'khor ba med cing 'khor ba po gang zag kyang med/ / do/ /bcu gnyis pa sngags kyi dam tshig gi gsang ba bshad pa ni/ de phyir bcos ma 'khor ba'i rnam rtog kun spangs nas/ / rtog bral gyi lha sku dang*/ bde stong gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi nges don gyi lam la/ / gsang sngags rig pa rnams rnam rtog ma byed cig / te don dam gyi dam tshig go /bcu gsum pa sngags kyi spyod pa bshad pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang po gsang sngags pa sa skye bo ni/ / skyes pa bud med ma ning*/ gang la'ang brnyas par mi bya ste// rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas btab pa'i phyir ro/ / nyan thos bye brag smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa'i lta ba mthar thug tu 'dod pa ste/ de dag gi thab skor nang du zhag bdun lta ci smos cung zad kyang mi gnas shing*/ /chags bral gyi lam bsam gtan dang gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin la blo mi gus/ / par bya/ bud med rin chen nam yang sems kyis spang bar mi bya/ / lus ngag gis kyang spyir dgag bya dgos pa'i dbye ba shes dgos mod/ gong du bshad pa'i dam tshig ma mtha' rnams nges par skyongs dgos/ rang don dang bden 'dzin can gyi nyan thos kyi spyod pa spangs byas nas/ /'dod chags bde ba chen po snying rje chen po 'char ba dang bcas/ / sems can so so 'dul ba'i thabs tshul kun yang rig pas/ / phyi rol gnyis sbyor gyi bya bas nang du gnyis sbyor las 'das pa'i 'dzag med kyi bde chen*/sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa ra bya 'o/ /sdom pa la blangs byar mi dang sdom min la spangs byar mi zhen pas/ de dag kun las sems log/ pa dang*/ bza' bya zhim po

dang bza' min mi gtsang ba sogs su mi brtag ste/ / rigs sogs gtsang dang mi gtsang gi dpyad pa mi bya/ / ste/ thams cad rang bzhin te stong nyid dang de kho na nyid de'i bde gsal du mnyam par shes/ / pas longs spyod pa'o/ / mgo zlum ni dge slong gi cha lugs sam/ thig les spyi bo gang ba'i don te brtul zhugs de yang gtum mo'i me rgyas pa'am des bde ba'i 'dod chags gzi brjid can/ / thams cad mnyam nyid dmigs su med pa la/ / rtog pa/ ngan 'gror 'khrid pa'i sdig pa dang bde 'gror 'khrid pa'i bsod nams dang lung ma bstan gyi gnas skabs kun yod pa min/ / 'o/ /'o ba ci zhe na dus dang spyod kun kyang byang chub kyi thabs su 'gyur ba'i spyod pa can/ / 'jig rten sems can g.yo ba'i rgyu/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams byed bud med yin yang 'dir ni thabs mchog gi khyad par gyi bud med la sbyor ba las ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab sogs la sems brtan pa/ / par byed pa/ tshangs spyod ma nyams pa'i dge slong dngos ste/ / de ni khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu grags pa/ lha gsum dang*/ phyogs skyong*/ rgyal chen bzhi/ lha min dbang po/ klu chen sogs kun gyi bla mar gyur/ / pa'o/ / rdo rje 'od gsal byin gyis rlob cing mthar phyin par byed pa'i ye shes kyi rim pa ston pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ rtog pa phyi ma gsang ba ni don gyi the tshom sel bas nges par bstan pa ji snyed pa ni 'di bas mang ba yod du rung yang*/ zhes pa'o/ / rdzogs te/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rtog pa ji snyed pa rdzogs so// // rgya gar lho phyogs rasmī shwa ra'i ljongs su sku 'khrungs pa rdo rje theg pa la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rje btsun bud+dha gup+ta la/ rgyud 'di zhib mor nyan cing bsgyur bar sla ba rnams tho re long ngai ba bsgyur zhing*/

dka' gnas rnams la reg zig gi rim pa mang du byas nas brtag dpyad mang du bgyis pa las/ slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po nirbā ṇa shrī'i zhabs dang*/ yang slad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa badz+ra'i spyan sngar 'grel pa so so dang zhib tu sbyar te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o// // bkra shis/ dge legs 'phel/ shu bhaṃ/ / ༈ rab tu zab cing rgya che ba/ /rgyud kun gsang ba ston byed 'di/ /mchan bus cung zad gsal byas pa'i/ /dge bas sangs rgyas thob par shog /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas dben gnas byang chub chen por bris pa ste/ bla ma dam pa paṇa grub rnam pa gsum gyis zhal gdams thugs bcud rang gi blo la ji ltar gnas pa rnams rjed byang du bkod cing*/ 'grel pa gnyis kyi khyad don rnam grangs su rung ba rnams kyang ci rigs par cung zad bkod pa ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba thams cad gsal bar byas pa yin pas/ 'di dbang thob cing*/ man ngag dang rgyud bshad/ zab bshad thob cing*/ mos pa brtan po can yin na ma gtogs/ mi bstan cing gsang ba'i bka' rgyas btab bo/ / rang lo so gsum pa la'o/ /maṅga laṃ bistar ku ru/ 'di bzhengs dge ba'i zla zer gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs sgo ku mud tshal/ / yongs rgyas dga' ston gsar ba'i dpal/ /srid mtha'i bar du nyams med shog /'di bzhengs legs dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu/ /nges don zab mor/ /ji bzhin spyod shog /ma tis so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ - PAGE 456 -- PAGE 537 -- PAGE 455 -
